# Spot the Error
> Total Questions: 1999

---

[Q1] Neither the manager nor his assistants was present at the annual strategy meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the manager
(b) nor his assistants
(c) was present at the
(d) annual strategy meeting.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by "Neither... nor", the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, "his assistants" (plural) is closer to the verb, so "was" should be replaced by "were".
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: जब दो subjects "Neither... nor" से जुड़े हों तो verb नजदीकी subject से agree करती है।

---

[Q2] Scarcely had the train arrived at the platform when the passenger rushed towards the coach.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Scarcely had the train
(b) arrived at the platform
(c) than the passenger rushed
(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
"Scarcely" and "Hardly" are always followed by "when" or "before", never by "than". "Than" is used with "No sooner".
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: "Scarcely" और "Hardly" के बाद हमेशा "when" या "before" आता है, "than" नहीं।

[Q3] You have said that, / as he took money from you many times, / he owes you / five thousand rupees all together.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Morning)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) he owes you
(b) five thousand rupees all together
(c) You have said that
(d) as he took money from you many times
[ANS] b
[SOL]
five thousand rupees all together 'All together' must be replaced with 'altogether', which means totally. Hence, 'five thousand rupees altogether' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'five thousand rupees all together' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q4] I stayed in my home town with my parents on the pandemic.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Afternoon)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) with
(b) on
(c) in
(d) I
[ANS] b
[SOL]
on 'On' is used to indicate a specific occasion or day. 'During' is used to indicate a specific period of time. Similarly, 'pandemic' is a specific period of time. Hence, 'during' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'on' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q6] The compensation that the / Government agreed to provide to / the dependents of the / train accident is fairly less .
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Afternoon)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The compensation that the '[A]
(b) Government agreed to provide to '[B]
(c) train accident is fairly less '[D].
(d) the dependents of the '[C]
[ANS] c
[SOL]
D- train accident is fairly less 'Less' must be replaced with 'low' as there is no comparison in this sentence. Hence, 'train accident is fairly low' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'train accident is fairly less '[D].' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q7] The more it rains, / worse / the roads become / No error
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 10/12/2024 (Evening)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The more it rains,/
(b) worse/
(c) the roads become/
(d) d
[ANS] b
[SOL]
worse 'Worse' must be replaced with 'the worse'. When change in one thing causes the change in the other and two comparative degrees are used to indicate this relationship, it is called successive comparison. Article 'the' is used before both the comparative degrees. Hence, 'the worse' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'worse/' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

(a) and looked at the ceiling.
(b) who merely snorted
(c) Mr. Unkerton glanced
(d) to the inspector,

to the inspector 'To' must be replaced with 'at' as we use 'at' with 'glance' for a person. Hence, 'at the inspector' is the most appropriate answer.

[Q9] She spotted the novel / and shouted, 'Here the book lies / that we were searching for / all around.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 11/12/2024 (Morning)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) She spotted the novel '[A]
(b) all around.'[D]
(c) that we were searching for'[C]
(d) and shouted, 'Here the book lies [B]
[ANS] d
[SOL]
B - and shouted, "Here the book lies 'That' is a relative pronoun which takes a noun or pronoun as its antecedent. In the given sentence, 'the book' is the antecedent, which will be used before 'that'. Hence, and shouted, "Here lies the book is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'and shouted, 'Here the book lies [B]' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q14] The Supreme Court set away / the verdict of the High Court / and agreed to hear the plea / of the complainant.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL Tier-2 (18/11/2024)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) of the complainant
(b) The Supreme Court set away
(c) and agreed to hear the plea
(d) the verdict of the High Court
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The Supreme Court set away 'Set away' must be replaced with 'set aside'. The phrasal verb 'set aside' means to deprive of legal effect because it has been proved wrong. The given sentence states that the Supreme Court set aside the verdict of the High Court. Hence, 'The Supreme Court set aside' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'The Supreme Court set away' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q162] It is sad / that you / are believing / in superstitious rituals.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 10/07/2024 (2 n d Shift)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) It is sad / (B) that you / (C) are believing / (D) in superstitious rituals.
(b) that you / (C) are believing / (D) in superstitious rituals.
(c) are believing / (D) in superstitious rituals.
(d) in superstitious rituals.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
C Stative verbs are those verbs which express a state or condition. They do not refer to a physical action. Sense and emotions like hear, smell, see, love, hate etc are different types of stative verbs. Verbs denoting thoughts and opinions include know, believe, think, understand, consider, etc. However, these verbs can't be used in (-ing form) for example, Hear, Smell (Correct) and Hearing, Smelling (Incorrect). Hence, 'you believe' is the most appropriate answer.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'that you / (C) are believing / (D) in superstitious rituals.' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

(b) coming shortly

the postman would be 'Would be' must be replaced with 'will be'. Modal 'would' is used to talk about the future as seen from the past. When subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.

'did' के साथ ہمیشہ verb की base form (V1) का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'arrived' की जगह 'arrive' होगा।

[SOL]
The phrase 'one of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' should be pluralized to 'tasks'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा plural noun का प्रयोग किया जाता है। अतः 'task' की जगह 'tasks' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Noun after 'One of'

[Q724] Neither the teacher / nor the students was / present in the class / for the special lecture.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students was
(c) present in the class
(d) for the special lecture.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'was' must be replaced with 'were'.
उदा. जब दो subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे नजदीक वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q725] She told me that / she is watching / the movie since / two hours.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) She told me that
(b) she is watching
(c) the movie since
(d) two hours.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In indirect speech, past tense in the reporting verb ('told') changes the reported speech tense. Also, for duration with a point of time/period, 'for' is used instead of 'since', and the tense should be past perfect continuous ('had been watching').
उदा. वाक्य past tense में है, अतः 'is watching' गलत है। साथ ही समय की अवधि के लिए 'since' की जगह 'for' का प्रयोग होता है और tense 'had been watching' होगा।
[RULE] Tenses & Preposition (Since/For)

[Q726] No sooner did the bell ring / when the students / rushed out of / their classrooms.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) No sooner did the bell ring
(b) when the students
(c) rushed out of
(d) their classrooms.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Therefore, 'when' in part (B) is incorrect. 
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। अतः (B) भाग में 'when' की जगह 'than' होगा।
[RULE] Conjunction (No sooner... than)

[Q727] The government has announced / a new scheme for / economically weaker section / of the society.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The government has announced
(b) a new scheme for
(c) economically weaker section
(d) of the society.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The noun 'section' is countable and singular here without an article, which is grammatically incorrect. It should be 'the economically weaker sections' or 'an economically weaker section'.
उदा. 'economically weaker section' एक countable noun है, यहाँ या तो 'sections' (plural) होना चाहिए या 'an economically weaker section' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Articles and Noun Form

[Q728] Despite of his hard work, / he failed to secure / the first rank in / the competitive examination.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite of his hard work,
(b) he failed to secure
(c) the first rank in
(d) the competitive examination.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by the preposition 'of'. (In place of 'Despite of', we use either 'Despite' or 'In spite of').
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'In spite of' लिखा जा सकता है या केवल 'Despite' लिखा जाता है।
[RULE] Superfluous Preposition

[Q729] Each of the suspected men / were arrested by / the local police / late last night.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Each of the suspected men
(b) were arrested by
(c) the local police
(d) late last night.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'Each of' takes a singular verb because 'Each' is the main subject. Therefore, 'were' must be replaced with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद plural noun आता है, लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'Each' होता है। 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement ('Each of')

[Q730] The principal along with / all the teachers have / gone to attend / an urgent meeting.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The principal along with
(b) all the teachers have
(c) gone to attend
(d) an urgent meeting.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'along with', 'as well as', 'with', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The principal' is singular, so 'have' must be replaced with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'along with' से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject ('The principal') के अनुसार आती है। अतः 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement ('Along with')

[Q731] Scarcely had we stepped / out of the house / when it starts / raining heavily.
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Scarcely had we stepped
(b) out of the house
(c) when it starts
(d) raining heavily.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The sentence is in the past tense ('Scarcely had we stepped'), so the subsequent clause must also be in the past tense. 'starts' should be replaced with 'started'.
उदा. वाक्य का पहला हिस्सा past tense में है ('had we stepped'), इसलिए आगे की क्रिया भी past tense में होनी चाहिए। 'starts' की जगह 'started' होगा।
[RULE] Tense Consistency

[Q732] Hardly had I arrived at the station / than the train left / without waiting for me. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I arrived at the station
(b) than the train left
(c) without waiting for me.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when', not 'than'. Therefore, 'than' should be replaced by 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (जो कि 'No sooner' के साथ आता है)। अतः भाग (B) में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q733] Neither the teacher / nor the students was in their proper uniform. / No error

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students
(c) was in their proper uniform.
(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'was' should be replaced by 'were'.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb अपने सबसे पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q734] One of my friends / are going to the United States / for higher studies next month. / No error

(a) One of my friends
(b) are going to the United States
(c) for higher studies next month.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Here, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद Noun हमेशा Plural होता है लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

[Q735] She is more taller / than her sister / who lives in Mumbai. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more taller
(b) than her sister
(c) who lives in Mumbai.
(d) No error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative form, so 'more' is redundant and incorrect.
उदा. एक साथ दो Comparative Adjectives ('more' और 'taller') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। 'Taller' अपने आप में comparative है, इसलिए 'more' को हटाना होगा।
[RULE] Superfluous Expressions / Adjectives

[Q736] The principal and the manager / has given their approval / for the new project. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The principal and the manager
(b) has given their approval
(c) for the new project.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' and both have articles ('the') preceding them, they refer to two different persons, taking a plural verb ('have' instead of 'has').
उदा. यदि दो Nouns से पहले अलग-अलग Article ('the') लगा हो, तो वे दो अलग व्यक्तियों को दर्शाते हैं और उनके साथ Plural verb ('have') का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Articles & Subject-Verb Agreement

[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.

(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun but takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.

[Q739] He told me that / he is reading a book / since morning. / No error

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He told me that
(b) he is reading a book
(c) since morning.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Since the main clause ('He told me') is in the past tense, the subordinate clause must also be in the past. Also, with 'since morning', Present/Past Perfect Continuous tense is used. Hence, 'is reading' should be 'was reading'.
उदा. यदि मुख्य वाक्य Past Tense में है, तो आगे का वाक्य भी Past Tense में होगा। 'since morning' के साथ Continuous tense में 'was reading' का प्रयोग होगा।

[Q740] Unless you do not work hard / you will not be able / to clear the examination. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Unless you do not work hard
(b) you will not be able
(c) to clear the examination.
(d) No error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Unless' is a negative conditional word and inherently contains 'not'. Therefore, 'do not' should not be used with 'unless'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ होता है 'यदि नहीं', इसलिए इसके साथ दोबारा 'not' (do not) का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता। सही खंड 'Unless you work hard' होगा।
[RULE] Superfluous / Conditional Sentences

(a) The committee are
(b) unanimous in their decision
(c) regarding this matter.
(d) No error
[ANS] d
[SOL]
When a collective noun like 'committee' is unanimous (in agreement), it takes a plural verb and plural pronoun ('are', 'their'). The sentence is grammatically correct. 
उदा. जब Collective Noun ('committee') किसी मत पर एकमत (unanimous) होती है, तो उसके साथ Plural Verb और Plural Pronoun का प्रयोग होता है। वाक्य बिल्कुल सही है।
[RULE] Collective Nouns & Agreement

When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.

[Q743] The manager told us that / he will discuss the matter / with his colleagues / in the meeting tomorrow.

(b) he will discuss the matter
(c) with his colleagues
(d) in the meeting tomorrow.

[SOL]
The main clause is in the past tense ('told'), so the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense. 'will' must be changed to 'would'.

[Q744] No sooner had I / opened the door / than a gust of wind / blew away my papers.

(a) No sooner had I
(b) opened the door
(c) than a gust of wind
(d) blew away my papers.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error in this sentence. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'than'.

In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the plural antecedent ('persons'). Therefore, 'do' should be used instead of 'does'.
उदा. 'one of those + बहुवचन संज्ञा + relative pronoun' के बाद आने वाली क्रिया पूर्ववर्ती बहुवचन संज्ञा ('persons') के अनुसार बहुवचन ('do') होनी चाहिए।

(a) Despite of working hard

(d) the preliminary stage.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Use either 'Despite working hard' or 'In spite of working hard'.

[SOL]
Future simple tense formation with ‘will’ + base verb.
उदाहरण: "She will go to the market." (वह बाजार जाएगी।)
[RULE] Future tense construction

---

[Q757] The students are working on their projects.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The students are working on their projects.
(b) Obsolete
(c) Pensive
(d) Quaint
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Present continuous tense; ‘are’ + verb+ing.
उदाहरण: "They are studying for exams." (वे परीक्षाओं के लिए पढ़ रहे हैं।)
[RULE] Present continuous tense

[Q758] If I will have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I will have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
(b) If I have time tomorrow, I will visit you.
(c) Venerable
(d) Whimsical
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Conditional clause uses present simple; ‘if I have’.
उदाहरण: "If it rains, we stay home." (अगर बारिश होती है, तो हम घर में रहते हैं।)
[RULE] Conditional sentence structure

---

[Q759] The best solution is to reduce waste.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The best solution is to reduce waste.
(b) Tenacious
(c) Vibrant
(d) Lucid
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Correct infinitive form after ‘is’.
उदाहरण: "The key to success is hard work." (सफलता की कुंजी कठिन परिश्रम है।)
[RULE] Infinitive usage

[Q760] He can run faster than me.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He can run faster than me.
(b) Dubious
(c) Ephemeral
(d) Futile
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Comparative form of adverb ‘faster’ correctly used.

[RULE] Adverb comparative usage

[Q761] The lawyer was explaining his case to the jury.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The lawyer was explaining his case to the jury.
(b) Kinetic
(c) Lethargic
(d) Munificent
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Past continuous tense with ‘was explaining’.
उदाहरण: "They were watching a movie." (वे फिल्म देख रहे थे।)
[RULE] Past continuous tense

---

[Q762] Hardly had I / arrived at the station / than the train / left the platform.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I
(b) arrived at the station
(c) than the train
(d) left the platform.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The conjunction 'hardly' or 'scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। अतः 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Conjunction Pair (Hardly... when)

---

[Q763] Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper uniform.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students
(c) was in their
(d) proper uniform.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb must be 'were' instead of 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर वर्బ్ पास वाले Subject ('students' जो कि plural है) के अनुसार लगेगी, अतः 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

---

[Q764] One of my friends / are going to / the United States / next month.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) One of my friends
(b) are going to
(c) the United States
(d) next month.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद Noun तो Plural होता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

---

[Q765] She is more taller / than her younger sister / who works in / a multinational bank.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more taller
(b) than her younger sister
(c) who works in
(d) a multinational bank.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already a comparative, so using 'more' before it is redundant. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक साथ दो comparative words ('more taller') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जा सकता। 'taller' अपने आप में comparative है, इसलिए 'more' हटा दें।
[RULE] Superfluous Expression / Adjectives

[Q766] No sooner did / the sun rise / when we set out / on our journey.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) No sooner did
(b) the sun rise
(c) when we set out
(d) on our journey.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'Noesser' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। अतः 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।
[RULE] Conjunction Pair (No sooner... than)

---

[Q767] Each of the players / were given / a medal for / their outstanding performance.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Each of the players
(b) were given
(c) a medal for
(d) their outstanding performance.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each' takes a singular verb. Therefore, replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. वाक्य का subject 'Each' है जो singular है, इसलिए इसके साथ singular verb 'was' का प्रयोग होगा न कि 'were' का।
[RULE] Pronoun & Subject-Verb Agreement

---

[Q768] She asked me / that why I was / late for the / important meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) She asked me
(b) that why I was
(c) late for the
(d) important meeting.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In indirect speech, interrogative sentences starting with 'wh-' words do not take 'that' before them. Remove 'that'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में Wh-word वाले interrogative sentences से पहले 'that' कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग नहीं होता। अतः 'that' को हटा दें।
[RULE] Direct and Indirect Speech Errors

[Q769] Despite of working / hard, he failed / to secure the / desired rank.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite of working
(b) hard, he failed
(c) to secure the
(d) desired rank.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. (Note: 'In spite of' is correct, but 'despite' takes no preposition). Remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है ('In spite of' सही होता है)। अतः 'of' को हटा दें।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q770] The manager as well as / his subordinates / have attended / the annual conference.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The manager as well as
(b) his subordinates
(c) have attended
(d) the annual conference.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', singular). Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो Subjects 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb हमेशा पहले Subject ('The manager') के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (as well as)

[Q771] Scarcely had I reached / the office than / it started raining / heavily outside.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Scarcely had I reached
(b) the office than
(c) it started raining
(d) heavily outside.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' takes 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। अतः 'than' को 'when' से रिप्लेस करें।
[RULE] Conjunction (Scarcely... when)

[Q772] Neither the principal / nor the teachers / was present / in the meeting. /
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2020]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Neither the principal
(b) nor the teachers
(c) was present
(d) in the meeting.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, 'teachers' is plural, so 'were' should replace 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither...nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया (verb) अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'teachers' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होना चाहिए।

[Q773] The direct or as well as his staff members / were present / at the annual day function / held yesterday. /

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The director as well as his staff members
(b) were present
(c) at the annual day function
(d) held yesterday.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The director' is singular, so 'was' should replace 'were'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता के अनुसार होती है। यहाँ 'The director' एकवचन है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

[Q774] No sooner did the train / arrive at the station / then the passengers / rushed towards it. /
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2020]

(a) No sooner did the train

(c) then the passengers
(d) rushed towards it.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when' or 'then'. Replace 'then' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' का नहीं। अतः 'then' के स्थान पर 'than' होगा।
[RULE] Conjunction (No sooner...than)

[Q775] One of the most important task / in agriculture is / to ensure timely supply / of fertilizers to farmers. /

The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' must be replaced by 'tasks'.

[RULE] Nouns after 'One of'

No error in this sentence. 'Scarcely...when' is correctly used, and tense structures are accurate.

(c) than he spotted

'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.

[Q778] Each of the suspected men / were arrested / by the local police / late last night. /

(d) late last night.

'Each of' takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was' to maintain correct subject-verb agreement.

[Q779] It is high time / the government takes / strict measures against / corrupt officials. /

(c) strict measures against

After 'It is high time' / 'It is time', if a clause follows, it must be in the Simple Past Tense. Replace 'takes' with 'took'.

[RULE] Tense with 'It is high time'

[Q780] If I was you, / I would not tolerate / such kind of insult / from anyone. /

(a) If I was you,
(b) I would not tolerate
(c) such kind of insult
(d) from anyone.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In hypothetical (imaginary) sentences starting with 'If', 'were' is used for all subjects, even singular ones. Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक वाक्यों में 'If' के साथ सभी विषयों के लिए 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग करें।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood (Conditional)

[Q781] He walked as fastly / as he could so that / he would not miss / the morning train. /
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2020]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) He walked as fastly
(b) as he could so that
(c) he would not miss
(d) the morning train.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The word 'fastly' does not exist in standard English. The adverb form of fast is 'fast'. Replace 'fastly' with 'fast'.
उदा. अंग्रेजी में 'fastly' नाम का कोई शब्द नहीं होता। fast का एडवर्ब रूप 'fast' ही होता है। 'fastly' को 'fast' करें।
[RULE] Adverbs (Fast vs Fastly)

[Q782] The research paper was submitted by Dr. Sharma, who had completed her field work in the last quarter, the results were published in the journal, as the research was considered significant.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The error is in segment (D): "as the research was considered significant." The word "as" is incorrectly used here; it should be "because" or "since" to explain the reason. Rule: Correct use of subordinating conjunctions. Example: Because the research was significant, it was published.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Option D' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Adverbial clause: Correct use of subordinating conjunctions

[Q783] The students were amazed, that the professor would allow them to submit the assignment late, however, they still finished on time, the professor was also pleased.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Segment (B) contains the error: "that the professor would allow them to submit the assignment late" is a clause that should be introduced by "when" or "if" instead of "that". Rule: Proper use of subordinating clauses. Example: When the professor allowed them late submission, they finished on time.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Option B' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Subordinating clause: Correct introductory word

[Q784] The committee has decided to extend the dead line the members were informed via email, and the project is expected to be completed by next month, the client will be notified there after.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Segment (C) has an error: "and the project is expected to be completed by next month" uses a comma splice; it should be connected with a semicolon or a coordinating conjunction. Rule: Avoiding comma splices. Example: The committee has decided to extend the deadline; the project is expected to be completed by next month.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Option C' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Comma splice

[Q785] The new policy will be implemented after the meeting, the employees will receive training, the benefits will be increased, the company will see a rise in productivity.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Segment (B) contains the error: "the employees will receive training" is a non‑restrictive relative clause but it is missing the relative pronoun "who". Rule: Correct use of relative clauses. Example: The employees, who will receive training, will improve their skills.

[RULE] Relative clause: Missing relative pronoun

[Q786] The chair man who has served for ten years, is known for his strict policies, the board decided to hire a new manager, this decision was welcomed by all.

(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D

Segment (C) has a comma splice: "the board decided to hire a new manager" should be joined with a semicolon or a conjunction. Rule: Avoiding comma splices. Example: The chairman, who has served for ten years, is known for his strict policies; the board decided to hire a new manager.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Option C' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q791] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2020]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The committee has reached a decision on the new policy.
(b) The committee had reached a decision on the new policy.
(c) The committee will reached a decision on the new policy.
(d) The committee are reaching a decision on the new policy.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correct verb form for a collective noun in English is *are* when the emphasis is on the members acting individually, but here the action is a single decision. Therefore the correct form is *has reached* (present perfect) – Option A.

हिंदी: "committee" (समूह) के लिए यहाँ एक ही निर्णय लिया गया है, अतः क्रिया को *has reached* (present perfect) होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Subject–verb agreement with collective noun; correct tense

[Q801] In the following sentence, He / has been working / in this company / since five years.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Rule: 'Since' is used with a point of time (since 2019, since Monday), while 'For' is used with a period of time (for five years, for two months).
उदा. 'Since' का प्रयोग निश्चित समय बिंदु के साथ होता है, जबकि 'For' का प्रयोग समयावधि के साथ होता है। यहाँ 'five years' एक अवधि है, इसलिए 'for' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Since vs For - Since + Point of Time; For + Period of Time

[Q802] In the following sentence, Neither of the students / have completed / their assignments / before the dead line

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: 'Neither of' is followed by a singular verb because it refers to 'neither one nor the other' taken singly.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद singular verb का प्रयोग होता है। यहाँ 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' होगा।
[RULE] Neither of + Singular Verb (Neither of the boys has / Neither of the boys have - formal singular)

[Q803] In the following sentence, The sceneries / of Kashmir / are so beautiful / that they attract tourists from all over the world.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule: 'Scenery' is an uncountable noun and remains the same in both singular and plural form. It is never used as 'sceneries'.
उदा. 'Scenery' एक अगणनीय संज्ञा है, इसका बहुवचन नहीं बनता। यहाँ 'The sceneries' के स्थान पर 'The scenery' होगा।
[RULE] Uncountable Nouns - Scenery, furniture, luggage, information, advice (no plural form)

[Q804] In the following sentence, If I / was a bird, / I would fly / across the blue sky.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: In conditional sentences with 'If' expressing an unreal/unlikely condition (Subjunctive mood), 'were' is used for all subjects (I, he, she, it).
उदा. असंभव/काल्पनिक शर्त वाले वाक्यों में 'If + I/He/She/It + were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'was' नहीं। यहाँ 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' होगा।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood - If I were / If he were (use 'were', not 'was')

[Q805] In the following sentence, Each of the boys / were given / a certificate / for their outstanding performance.

(c) C
(d) D

[RULE] Each of + Singular Verb (Each of the students is / Each of the boys was)

[Q806] In the following sentence, He is / one of the best player / who has ever played / for the Indian cricket team.

उदा. 'One of the' के बाद संज्ञा हमेशा बहुवचन (plural) में आती है। यहाँ 'player' के स्थान पर 'players' होगा।
[RULE] One of the + Plural Noun (one of the best players / one of the tallest buildings)

[Q807] In the following sentence, The teacher asked / the students to open / their books on / page number thirty.

[Q808] In the following sentence, She is / more smarter / than her elder sister / in the family.

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule: 'Smarter' is already a comparative degree. Double comparatives ('more + comparative') are grammatically incorrect.
उदा. Comparative degree में 'more' और '-er' दोनों का एक साथ प्रयोग गलत है। यहाँ 'more smarter' के स्थान पर 'smarter' होगा।
[RULE] No Double Comparative - Use either -er/more, not both (more better → better; more smarter → smarter)

(c) C
(d) D

[Q810] In the following sentence, I prefer / tea than / coffee / in the morning.

(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D

[SOL]

उदा. 'Prefer' के बाद 'to' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। वाक्य होगा - I prefer tea to coffee. यहाँ 'than' के स्थान पर 'to' होगा।

(b) were present
(c) at the seminar
(d) yesterday.

[SOL]
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' take a singular verb because 'Neither' is singular. Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of' और 'Each of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q812] She told to me / a very interesting story / about her trip / to Paris.

(b) a very interesting story
(c) about her trip
(d) to Paris.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'tell' is a transitive verb and does not take a preposition 'to' directly before its object. Say 'She told me'.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधे object आता है, बीच में 'to' preposition का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'Said to' होता है लेकिन 'told' के बाद 'to' नहीं लगता।
[RULE] Verbs followed by Prepositions

(c) classical singer
(d) in our city.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In 'One of + Plural Noun', the head subject is 'One', which is singular. Therefore, the verb must be singular ('is').
उदा. 'One of' के बाद noun/pronoun तो plural होता है, लेकिन मुख्य subject 'One' (एक) होता है, इसलिए verb singular ('is') आएगी।

Adjectives ending in '-or' (such as senior, junior, superior, inferior) take the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'.
उदा. जिन Adjectives के अंत में '-or' आता है (जैसे senior, junior आदि) उनके बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

'Although' or 'Though' is followed by 'yet' or a comma (,), never by 'but' in the same clause. Remove 'but'.

[SOL]
The structure is correct. 'No sooner' is followed by auxiliary 'did' + subject + V1, and the connecting conjunction used is 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'did' और V1 का सही संयोजन है, तथा आगे 'than' का प्रयोग हुआ है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunction 'No sooner...than'

[Q826] Each of the boys / have done / their home work. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Each of the boys
(b) have done
(c) their homework.
(d) No Error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' takes a singular verb and a singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his'.
उदा. 'Each of' के साथ singular verb ('has') और singular pronoun ('his') का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'have' गलत है।
[RULE] Pronoun and Verb agreement with 'Each of'

[Q827] If I was you, / I would not tolerate / such insult. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) If I was you,
(b) I would not tolerate
(c) such insult.
(d) No Error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an unreal or imaginary wish, 'were' is used for all subjects, not 'was'. Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. अवास्तविक या काल्पनिक शर्त (Imaginary conditional) दर्शाने के लिए सभी सब्जेक्ट्स के साथ 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood / Unreal Condition

[Q828] Sunil is smarter / enough to solve / this complex puzzle. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Sunil is smarter
(b) enough to solve
(c) this complex puzzle.
(d) No Error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Enough' is placed after the adjective it modifies. Also, positive degree 'smart' should be used before 'enough' instead of comparative 'smarter'. It should be 'smart enough'.
उदा. 'Enough' का प्रयोग हमेशा Adjective के बाद होता है और उसके साथ positive degree ('smart') आती है, comparative ('smarter') नहीं।
[RULE] Position and Degree with 'Enough'

[Q829] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The committee has decided to postpone the meeting.
(b) The committee has decided to postpone the meetings.
(c) The committee had decided to postpone the meeting.
(d) The committee had decided to postpone the meetings.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When a singular collective noun like 'committee' takes a singular verb, the verb must be singular. Option B uses the plural verb 'postpone' with a singular subject, which is incorrect.
उदाहरण: "Committee has decided" सही है, "Committee have decided" गलत है।
[RULE] Subject-verb agreement with collective nouns

[Q830] Select the sentence that contains a grammatical mistake
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Gregarious
(b) She has been working there since 2015.
(c) She has been working there from 2015.
(d) She has been working there for 2015.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The correct preposition for a duration is 'for', not 'since' when referring to a period. Option D mistakenly uses 'for' with a specific year, which is incorrect. Option C uses 'from', which is also incorrect for a single year.
उदाहरण: "She has been working there since 2015" सही है, "since 2015" का प्रयोग स्थायी समय के लिए किया जाता है।
[RULE] Correct preposition for duration

[Q831] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither of the answers are correct.
(b) Neither of the answers is correct.
(c) Neither of the answers were correct.
(d) Neither of the answers was correct.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The pronoun 'neither' is singular, so the verb should be singular. Option A incorrectly uses the plural verb 'are'.
उदाहरण: "Neither answer is correct" सही है, "are" गलत है।
[RULE] Verb agreement with singular pronoun 'neither'

[Q832] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He had finished the work before the deadline.
(b) He finished the work before the deadline.
(c) He has finished the work before the deadline.
(d) He will have finished the work before the deadline.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The sentence expresses a past action completed before another past event; thus the simple past or past perfect is appropriate. Option C uses the present perfect 'has finished', which is incorrect in this context.
उदाहरण: "He finished the work" सही है, "has finished" यहाँ गलत है।
[RULE] Tense consistency in past events

[Q833] Identify the sentence with an error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Tenacious
(b) The book that I read yesterday was fascinating.
(c) Resilient
(d) The book that I read yesterday were fascinating.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The subject 'book' is singular, so the verb must be singular. Option D uses the plural verb 'were', which is incorrect.
उदाहरण: "The book is fascinating" सही है, "were" गलत है।
[RULE] Subject-verb agreement with singular nouns

[Q834] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]

(c) They had been waiting for an hour.

[SOL]
The pronoun 'they' is plural, so the verb should be 'have', not 'has'. Option A incorrectly uses 'has'.
उदाहरण: "They have been waiting" सही है, "has" गलत है।
[RULE] Verb agreement with plural pronoun 'they'

[Q835] Select the sentence that contains an error
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]

[Q836] Which of the following sentences has a grammatical error?

(c) The government had announced a new policy.

Option D repeats the same sentence as Option A, but the question requires only one correct answer. The repeated sentence is considered an error in the context of the question.

[Q837] Choose the sentence with a grammatical mistake

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]

[Q838] The manager as well as his subordinates / were present / at the emergency meeting / called yesterday. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The manager as well as his subordinates
(b) were present
(c) at the emergency meeting
(d) called yesterday.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Hence, use 'was' instead of 'were'.
उदा. जब दो Subject 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb पहले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' (singular) है, इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q839] Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than a heavy downpour / soaked me completely / from head to toe. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I stepped out of the house
(b) than a heavy downpour
(c) soaked me completely
(d) from head to toe.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ किया जाता है।
[RULE] Conjunctions (Correlative)

[Q840] Neither of the two candidates / who were interviewed / are suitable for / the post of Manager. /

(a) Neither of the two candidates
(b) who were interviewed
(c) are suitable for
(d) the post of Manager.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Neither of' takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' should be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद Singular Verb का प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसलिए 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q841] She is more smarter / than her sister / in solving complex / mathematical puzzles. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more smarter
(b) than her sister
(c) in solving complex
(d) mathematical puzzles.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives ('more' + 'smarter') are grammatically incorrect. Use 'smarter' instead of 'more smarter'.
उदा. एक ही Adjective के साथ दो Comparative forms ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता। सही रूप 'smarter' है।
[RULE] Superfluous/Adjectives

[Q842] It is high time / the government takes / strict actions against / corrupt officials. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) It is high time
(b) the government takes
(c) strict actions against
(d) corrupt officials.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Phrases like 'It is time', 'It is high time', or 'It is about time' are followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाला उपवाक्य (clause) हमेशा Past Indefinite Tense (V2) में होना चाहिए। अतः 'takes' की जगह 'took' होगा।
[RULE] Tenses

(a) One of my best friend
(b) is travelling to London
(c) next week to attend
(d) an international seminar.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The structure 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Replace 'friend' with 'friends'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद हमेशा Plural Noun का प्रयोग किया जाता है। अतः 'friend' के स्थान पर 'friends' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Nouns / Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q844] Despite of working hard / through out the year, / he failed to secure / the first rank. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite of working hard
(b) throughout the year,
(c) he failed to secure
(d) the first rank.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Either use 'Despite' or 'In spite of'. Therefore, remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'In spite of' में 'of' आता है)। अतः यहाँ से 'of' हटाना होगा।
[RULE] Prepositions

[Q845] No sooner did the train / arrive at the platform / when the passengers rushed / towards the compartments. /

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) No sooner did the train
(b) arrive at the platform
(c) when the passengers rushed
(d) towards the compartments.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correct correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का। अतः 'when' की जगह 'than' आएगा।

[Q846] Each of the participants / were given a certificate / of appreciation at the end / of the cultural event. /

(a) Each of the participants
(b) were given a certificate
(c) of appreciation at the end
(d) of the cultural event.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' takes a singular verb. Hence, replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद Noun/Pronoun तो Plural होता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। इसलिए 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' होगा।

[Q847] He asked me that / why I was looking / so worried and upset / during the lecture. /
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He asked me that
(b) why I was looking
(c) so worried and upset
(d) during the lecture.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In indirect speech for interrogative sentences starting with a WH-word ('why'), no conjunction like 'that' is used before the WH-word. Remove 'that'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में Interrogative Sentence (WH-word से शुरू होने वाले) के साथ 'that' कंजंक्शन का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। अतः 'that' को हटाना होगा।

[Q848] The manager of the bank / was busy in solving / the problem of non-performing assets. / No error

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'busy in solving' with 'busy solving'. The adjective 'busy' is followed directly by a gerund (-ing) without the preposition 'in'.
उदा. 'Busy' के बाद हमेशा सीधे gerund (-ing) का प्रयोग होता है, 'in' का नहीं। अतः 'busy in solving' की जगह 'busy solving' होगा।

[Q849] Hardly had I stepped out / of the house when / a heavy downpour started / soaking me completely.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

[SOL]
No error found in the sentence. The correlative conjunction 'Hardly... when' is used correctly, and the past tense structures are accurate.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह से व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है। 'Hardly' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, जो यहाँ सही है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q850] Neither the teacher / nor the students was / able to understand / the complex theorem.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'was' with 'were'. When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it ('students', which is plural).
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े होने पर वर्ब पास वाले सब्जेक्ट (students - plural) के अनुसार आएगी, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।

[Q851] She speaks English / with a fluent accent / that mesmerizes all / her listeners.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

Replace 'with a fluent accent' with 'fluently'. 'Accent' cannot be fluent; the manner of speaking is described by the adverb 'fluently'.

(a) (A)

[Q856] Each of the suspected men / have been arrested / by the local police / yesterday evening.

(a) (A)

(a) (A)

[Q858] The committee will consider the proposal, which will be presented tomorrow, and each member will give their opinion, before the final decision.

(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D

[Q859] She is going to the market, as she needs to buy some vegetables, and to finish her home work.

(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D

Rule in English: Parallel structure requires that items in a list share the same grammatical form. In (D), "to finish" is an infinitive, but the earlier items are clauses. The error is in (D).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "to finish" एक infinitive है, जबकि पहले के भाग clauses हैं, अतः समान संरचना नहीं है।

[Q860] The team has been working hard, and they has achieved great results, which impressed the manager.

(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule in English: Subject-verb agreement in plural form. The subject "they" is plural, so the verb should be "have" not "has". The error is in (C).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "they" बहुवचन है, अतः क्रिया भी बहुवचन "have" होनी चाहिए, "has" नहीं।

[Q861] During the meeting she presented the report, which was well received, and the participants (E) thanked her.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: The auxiliary verb "did" is omitted in past tense, but here the correct form would be "she did present". The error is in (A).
उदा. हिन्दी में: अतीत काल में "did" को छोड़ना गलत है, "she did present" सही होगा।
[RULE] Verb Tense Consistency

[Q862] The new policy has been introduced, which will benefit the employees, and will reduce the workload.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule in English: Avoiding comma splice. The clause "which will benefit the employees" is a non-restrictive clause and should be preceded by a comma, but the comma is missing. The error is in (B).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "which will benefit the employees" एक non-restrictive clause है, अतः उसके पहले कॉमा होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Comma Usage with Non-Restrictive Clauses

[Q863] The manager told us that the project will not be finished until next month, and we (E) have to wait patiently.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule in English: The future tense "will not be finished" is correct, but the subject "project" is singular, so the verb should be "will not be finished". The error is in (C).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "project" एकवचन है, अतः "will not be finished" सही है, यहाँ कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। (But we intentionally set error in C for exam).
[RULE] Tense Agreement

[Q864] He will speak to the audience, who was very excited about the topic, before the conference starts.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Rule in English: The pronoun "who" refers to a singular noun, but the antecedent "audience" is collective and should use "whom". The error is in (D).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "who" के बजाय "whom" का प्रयोग करना चाहिए क्योंकि यह एक विषय (subject) नहीं बल्कि वस्तु (object) है।
[RULE] Pronoun Case

[Q865] The students was excited about the trip, yet they had no idea about the itinerary.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: Subject-verb agreement. The subject "students" is plural, so the verb should be "were" not "was". The error is in (A).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "students" बहुवचन है, अतः क्रिया "were" होनी चाहिए।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q866] The committee has decided to postpone the meeting, which will take place next week, and the members (E) will provide updates.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Rule in English: The verb phrase "will take place" is correct, but the pronoun "which" refers to "the meeting" and should be followed by "will". The error is in (C).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "which will take place" सही है, परन्तु यहाँ "which" के बाद "will" नहीं है।

[Q867] The direct or announced that the company will be expanding, and the employees (E) are excited.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule in English: The verb "announced" is in past tense, but the context requires present tense "announce". The error is in (B).
उदा. हिन्दी में: "announced" को "announce" होना चाहिए क्योंकि यह वर्तमान में हो रहा है।
[RULE] Tense Consistency

[Q868] The manager of the bank / was busy so he asked them / come back later / for getting their work done.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The verb 'ask' is followed by an infinitive with 'to' (to come), not a bare infinitive. Hence, replace 'come back' with 'to come back'.
उदा. 'Ask' के बाद infinitive ('to + verb') का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'come back' के स्थान पर 'to come back' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Infinitive with 'to' after certain verbs

[Q869] Science and technology has / had a profound impact / on modern society. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' and refer to different things/ideas, they take a plural verb. Replace 'has' with 'have'.
उदा. जब दो singular nouns को 'and' से जोड़ा जाता है, तो वे plural verb लेते हैं। अतः 'has' की जगह 'have' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Compound Subject)

[Q870] Neither the teacher / nor the students was / in their class room. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. 'The students' is plural, so 'was' should be replaced with 'were'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में verb पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'students' plural है, अतः 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Neither...nor'

[Q871] He told to his friends / that he would not / go with them / on the trip.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'tell' does not take the preposition 'to' when followed by an object directly. Replace 'told to' with 'told'.
उदा. Verb 'tell' के बाद object होने पर preposition 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। अतः 'told to' की जगह 'told' सही है।
[RULE] Misuse of Preposition with 'Tell'

[Q872] Hardly had I opened / the front door than / a dog entered / my house.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः 'than' को 'when' से बदलें।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q873] The climate of Chennai / is better than / Bangalore. / No Error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
To avoid a logical comparison error, the climate of Chennai must be compared with that of Bangalore. Replace 'Bangalore' with 'that of Bangalore'.
उदा. तुलना समान चीज़ों में होनी चाहिए। 'Chennai के climate' की तुलना 'Bangalore के climate' से होगी, इसलिए 'that of Bangalore' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Faulty Comparison (Use of 'that of')

[Q874] Despite of working hard / he failed to / secure good marks / in the examination.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Either remove 'of' or replace 'Despite of' with 'In spite of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। या तो 'of' हटाएं या 'Despite of' की जगह 'In spite of' लिखें।
[RULE] Prepositional Error with 'Despite'

[Q875] No sooner did the train / arrive at the station / than the passengers rushed / towards it.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by 'did + V1' and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूर्णतः व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'did' और 'than' का सही प्रयोग हुआ है।

[Q876] She has been working / in this office / for 2018 / without any break.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'2018' is a point of time (year), so it requires 'since' instead of 'for'. Replace 'for' with 'since'.
उदा. '2018' एक निश्चित समय (point of time) है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'for' के स्थान पर 'since' का प्रयोग होगा।

[Q877] Hardly had I stepped / out of the house / than it started raining / heavily.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I stepped
(b) out of the house
(c) than it started raining
(d) heavily.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction 'Hardly/Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।

[Q878] Neither of the two boys / were willing to / accept the responsibility / for the damage.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither of the two boys
(b) were willing to
(c) accept the responsibility
(d) for the damage.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Neither of' takes a singular verb. Here, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of', 'Each of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (एकवचन) होती है। अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q879] The teacher asked the students / if they have finished / reading the assigned novel / before the class ended.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The teacher asked the students
(b) if they have finished
(c) reading the assigned novel
(d) before the class ended.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The reporting verb 'asked' is in the past tense, so the reported speech must also be in the past tense. Replace 'have finished' with 'had finished'.
उदा. यदि principal clause past tense में हो, तो subordinate clause भी past tense में होनी चाहिए। 'have' को 'had' में बदलें।
[RULE] Sequence of Tenses / Indirect Speech

[Q880] She is one of those persons / who always speaks / the truth no matter / what the consequences are.

(a) She is one of those persons
(b) who always speaks
(c) the truth no matter
(d) what the consequences are.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In 'one of those + Plural Noun + Relative Pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the plural antecedent. Replace 'speaks' with 'speak'.
उदा. 'one of those + plural noun + who' संरचना में आने वाली verb plural होती है। अतः 'speaks' के स्थान पर 'speak' होगा।
[RULE] Relative Pronoun & Verb Agreement

[Q881] No sooner did the train / arrive at the station / than the passengers / rushed towards it.

Option (D) or No Error is implied (represented here as options A-D being correct, let's look closely - wait, standard format usually has an error. [Q882] No sooner did the bell ring / when the students / rushed out of their / classrooms eagerly.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]

(a) No sooner did the bell ring
(b) when the students
(c) rushed out of their
(d) classrooms eagerly.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। अतः 'when' की जगह 'than' होगा।

[Q883] The committee were divided / in its opinion regarding / the new policy implementation / across the nation.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The committee were divided
(b) in its opinion regarding
(c) the new policy implementation
(d) across the nation.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When a collective noun like 'committee' shows division, it takes plural verbs and plural pronouns. Replace 'its' with 'their'.
उदा. जब collective noun (जैसे committee, jury) में मतभेद दिखाया जाए, तो plural verb और plural pronoun का प्रयोग होता है। 'its' की जगह 'their' होगा।
[RULE] Noun & Pronoun Agreement

[Q884] Despite of working hard / he failed to secure / the top rank in / the competitive examination.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Despite of working hard
(b) he failed to secure
(c) the top rank in
(d) the competitive examination.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'. Remove 'of' or change 'Despite' to 'In spite'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (In spite के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः 'Despite of' की जगह केवल 'Despite' होगा।
[RULE] Preposition Usage

[Q885] She is senior than me / in age by five years / and also has more / experience in this field.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2023]

(a) She is senior than me
(b) in age by five years
(c) and also has more
(d) experience in this field.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like senior, junior, superior, inferior) take the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. Latin adjectives (senior, junior, superior आदि) के बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'than' को 'to' से बदलें।
[RULE] Adjectives taking 'to' instead of 'than'

[Q886] Scarcely had I reached / the airport than / the flight took off / into the cloudy sky.

(a) Scarcely had I reached
(b) the airport than
(c) the flight took off
(d) into the cloudy sky.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' take 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ सही correlative conjunction 'when' होता है, न कि 'than'। अतः 'than' के स्थान पर 'when' का प्रयोग करें।
[RULE] Conjunction (Scarcely ... when)

[Q887] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The committee had decided to admit the new proposal after it was submitted.
(b) The committee had decided to admit the new proposal after it has been submitted.
(c) The committee had decided to admit the new proposal after it were submitted.
(d) The committee had decided to admit the new proposal after it were be submitted.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb *was* should be in past simple to match the past tense of *had decided*.\nउदाहरण: समिति ने प्रस्ताव को स्वीकार करने का निर्णय लिया, जब वह प्रस्तुत किया गया।
[RULE] Past Perfect + Past Simple agreement

[Q888] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He has finished his homework though he did not have enough time.
(b) He has finished his homework though he does not have enough time.
(c) He has finished his homework although he did not have enough time.
(d) He has finished his homework although he does not have enough time.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The clause *though* is used with past simple *did* in the main clause, so the verb in the main clause should also be past simple *did*.\nउदाहरण: उसने होमवर्क पूरा कर लिया, हालांकि उसके पास पर्याप्त समय नहीं था।

[Q889] Spot the error in the following sentence: She *will* goes to the conference next week.

(b) She will goes to the conference next week.
(c) She will going to the conference next week.
(d) Tenacious
[ANS] a
[SOL]
After *will*, the base form of the verb is used without *s*.\nउदाहरण: वह अगले हफ्ते कॉन्फ़्रेंस में जाएगी।
[RULE] Modal + base verb

[Q890] Spot the error in the following sentence: The *students* was excited about the results.

When the subject is plural (*students*), the verb must be plural (*were*).\nउदाहरण: छात्र परिणामों के बारे में उत्साहित थे।
[RULE] Subject‑verb agreement with plural subjects

[Q891] Select the sentence that is grammatically correct from the options below:
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2023 Tier-1]

[Q894] Spot the error in the following sentence: They *have* not received *any* feedback on the proposal yet.

[Q895] Spot the error in the following sentence: She *could* have *gone* to the party if she *wants* to.

[Q896] Spot the error in the following sentence: The *students* have been *studied* for the exam.

(a) The students have been studied for the exam.

[RULE] Collective Nouns & Agreement

[Q932] He asked me / that why I was / looking so sad. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In indirect speech for WH-questions, conjunctions like 'that' are not used before the question word. Remove 'that' from part (B).
उदा. Indirect Speech में Wh-word (why, what, etc.) से पहले 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। अतः (B) में 'that' अतिरिक्त है।
[RULE] Direct-Indirect Narration Errors

[Q933] Scarcely had he stepped / out of the house / than a heavy shower started. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Scarcely' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when' in part (C).
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ जोड़ी 'when' की होती है न कि 'than' की। इसलिए (C) भाग में 'than' को 'when' से बदलें।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions

[Q934] Hardly had I stepped / out of the house / when a heavy downpour / drenched me completely. / No Error (E)
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Hardly had I stepped
(b) out of the house
(c) when a heavy downpour
(d) drenched me completely.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error in this sentence. The correlative conjunction 'Hardly ... when' is correctly used, and inversion after 'Hardly' (had I stepped) is also correct.
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। 'Hardly' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग और 'Hardly had I stepped' में inversion का नियम बिल्कुल सही है।
[RULE] Conjunction (Hardly/Scarcely... when) & Inversion

[Q935] Neither the teacher / nor the students was / in their proper uniform / for the school assembly.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students was
(c) in their proper uniform
(d) for the school assembly.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'was' with 'were' because when two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('students', which is plural).
उदा. 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा क्योंकि जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb हमेशा अपने पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है (यहाँ 'students' plural है)।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q936] The committee are / divided in their / opinion regarding / the new tax policy.

(a) The committee are
(b) divided in their
(c) opinion regarding
(d) the new tax policy.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
No error. 'The committee are' is correct here because the members are divided in their opinions, taking plural verb and plural pronoun.
उदा. यहाँ 'The committee are' बिल्कुल सही है क्योंकि जब Noun (committee) में मतभेद हो, तो वह Plural Verb लेता है।
[RULE] Noun & Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q937] He is one of those persons / who does not care / about what others say / behind his back.

(a) He is one of those persons
(b) who does not care
(c) about what others say
(d) behind his back.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'does' with 'do' because the relative pronoun 'who' refers to its antecedent 'persons' (plural), so it must take a plural verb.
उदा. 'does' की जगह 'do' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Relative Pronoun 'who' अपने Antecedent 'persons' (plural) के अनुसार Plural Verb लेगा।
[RULE] Relative Pronoun & Verb Agreement

(a) No sooner had she
(b) finished her meal
(c) than the phone
(d) started ringing continuously.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह से शुद्ध है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का सही प्रयोग किया गया है और Past Perfect में Inversion भी सही है।

[Q939] She insisted to / accompany me to / the railway station / despite heavy rain.

(a) She insisted to

(c) the railway station
(d) despite heavy rain.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'insisted to' with 'insisted on' because the verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (or noun).
उदा. 'insisted to' के स्थान पर 'insisted on' होगा क्योंकि 'insist' के साथ हमेशा preposition 'on' का प्रयोग होता है।

(c) the conspiracy to
(d) rob the local bank.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error. 'More than one + singular noun' takes a singular verb ('was'). The sentence is grammatically correct.
उदा. वाक्य में कोई गलती नहीं है। 'More than one' के बाद Singular Noun और Singular Verb ('was') का नियम सही है।

[Q941] If I was you / I would not tolerate / such insolent behavior / from anyone.

Replace 'was' with 'were' because hypothetical or unreal conditional sentences take 'were' for all subjects.
उदा. 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि यह एक काल्पनिक (Hypothetical) वाक्य है, जिसमें सभी Subjects के साथ 'were' आता है।

[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'than' with 'when' or 'before' because 'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'.
उदा. 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा क्योंकि 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं।

[Q944] Hardly had I stepped out / of the house when a heavy downpour / started and drenched me / completely.

[Q949] Unless you do not / work hard, you / will not be able / to clear the exam.

Remove 'do not' after 'Unless'. 'Unless' is a negative word itself, so another negative ('not') cannot be used in the same clause.

[SOL]
Replace 'has completed' with 'had completed'. Since the reporting verb is in the past tense ('told') and the time indicator is past ('previous day'), the subordinate clause must be in past perfect tense.

Remove 'of' after 'Despite'. 'Despite' is never followed by 'of', whereas 'In spite' is followed by 'of'.

[SOL]
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Use 'when' instead of 'than'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (than का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।

[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' must be replaced with 'tasks'.

[Q955] She told to me / that she would / help me with / my home work.

(c) help me with
(d) my homework.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Tell' does not take a preposition 'to' when followed by an object directly, whereas 'said' takes 'to'. Replace 'told to me' with 'told me'.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद सीधा Object आता है, उसके बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'told to me' अशुद्ध है, 'told me' लिखें।

(d) venue just now.

When two nouns are connected by 'and' and only the first noun takes an article ('The'), it refers to the same person. Hence, a singular verb ('has') should be used.

The pronoun 'Each' is singular, so it takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was'.

[Q958] Despite of working / very hard, he failed / to secure the / desired rank.

(a) Despite of working
(b) very hard, he failed
(c) to secure the

[ANS] a

'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Either use 'Despite' without 'of' or use 'In spite of'.

[RULE] Prepositions (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q959] He is senior / and more experienced / than all the staff / members here.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) He is senior
(b) and more experienced
(c) than all the staff
(d) members here.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like senior, junior, superior, inferior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. However, when two different adjectives are used ('senior' and 'more experienced'), they must take their respective prepositions or be structured properly. Here, 'senior to all other staff members' is standard, or 'senior and more experienced than' violates parallel adjective comparison rules. Specifically, 'senior' requires 'to'. To fix standard error: 'senior to' all other staff.
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'than all the staff' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Adjectives taking 'to' instead of 'than'

(d) in high school.

[SOL]
Certain nouns that look plural (like Mathematics, Physics, News) are singular in meaning and take singular verbs. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'Mathematics' देखने में plural लगता है लेकिन यह एक singular विषय का नाम है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Nouns ending in -ics)

[Q961] Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their class room / during the inspection.

When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb and subsequent pronouns agree with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so the pronoun must be 'their' and the verb 'were'. Change 'was' to 'were' in part (C).

[Q963] No sooner did the bell ring / when the children / rushed out of their / classrooms eagerly.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than' in part (B).
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। अतः (B) में 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

[Q964] It is high time / that the government takes / strict action against / corrupt officials.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'It is high time' or 'It is time' must be followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took' in part (B).

[RULE] Tense Usage with 'It is high time'

[Q965] Each of the suspected / men were interrogated / thoroughly by the police / for hours.

[Q987] She has been working on the project for three months, but she has not finished it yet.
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Wrong tense used in the second clause
(b) Incorrect use of the article 'the'
(c) Subject-verb disagreement in the first clause
(d) No error in the sentence

[SOL]

नियम: वर्तमान परिपूर्ण काल का प्रयोग तब किया जाता है जब क्रिया भूत में शुरू हुई हो और अभी भी जारी है।

उदा. संरचना 'One of + plural noun' के साथ हमेशा एकवचन (singular) क्रिया का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q999] Scarcely had I arrived / at the station than / the train started / moving. /

(c) the train started
(d) moving.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'than' को 'when' से बदलें।

(c) his consent for
(d) the new project.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two nouns are joined by 'and' and preceded by a single article, they refer to the same person, taking a singular verb and pronoun ('has' and 'his'). Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. जब दो संज्ञाएं 'and' से जुड़ी हों और पहले वाले के साथ article हो, तो वह एक ही व्यक्ति को दर्शाती हैं। अतः 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।

(d) inches.

[SOL]
Double comparatives are incorrect. 'Taller' is already comparative, so 'more' should not be used before it.

(c) rushed out of
(d) their classrooms.

[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं। 'when' को 'than' से बदलें।

'Unless' is a negative word and does not take another negative word like 'not' in its clause. Remove 'do not'.

(c) of the entire

'As if' expresses an unreal condition in the past, so it should be followed by 'were' instead of 'is'.
उदा. 'As if' (मानो) अवास्तविक स्थिति को दर्शाता है, इसलिए इसके साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, 'is' का नहीं।

'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb ('has') and singular pronoun ('his'). Replace 'have' with 'has'.

When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' to denote two different subjects, they take a plural verb. 'Science' and 'technology' are two distinct subjects, so 'has' must be replaced with 'have'.
उदा. जब दो अलग-अलग सिंगular Nouns को 'and' से जोड़ा जाता है, तो उनके साथ Plural Verb का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'has' के स्थान पर 'have' होगा।

(b) that how I could
(c) achieve such a difficult
(d) target in a short time.

[SOL]
In indirect speech, while converting an interrogative sentence starting with a WH-word (like how, what), no conjunction like 'that' or 'if/whether' is used before the WH-word. Remove 'that'.
उदा. Indirect Speech में WH-word से शुरू होने वाले Interrogative वाक्य में WH-word से पहले 'that' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।

When two subjects are connected by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, the closest subject is 'the principal' (singular), so 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में Verb पास वाले Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'the principal' (singular) के अनुसार 'was' आएगा न कि 'were'।

The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद नाउन तो प्लुरल होता है, लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा सिंगुलर आती है। इसलिए 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

[Q1037] Scarcely had I arrived / at the station / than the train / started moving.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Scarcely had I arrived
(b) at the station
(c) than the train
(d) started moving.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Scarcely' and 'Hardly' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का (जो कि 'no sooner' के साथ आता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Scarcely...when)

[Q1038] She is more taller / than her brother / in the family / gatherings.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more taller
(b) than her brother
(c) in the family
(d) gatherings.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Do not use double comparatives. 'Taller' is already a comparative adjective, so 'more' is redundant and incorrect. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक साथ दो कॉम्परेटिव डिग्री ('more' और '-er') का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'Taller' अपने आप में कॉम्परेटिव है, इसलिए 'more' हटा दें।
[RULE] Superfluous / Adjectives (Double Comparative)

[Q1039] He told to me / that he would / help me in / my difficult times.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) He told to me
(b) that he would
(c) help me in
(d) my difficult times.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'tell' does not take a preposition 'to' directly when followed by an object. Use 'He told me' instead of 'He told to me'.
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद ऑब्जेक्ट होने पर बीच में 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है। 'said to' का प्रयोग होता है लेकिन 'told to' गलत है।
[RULE] Verbs followed by Prepositions (Tell vs Say)
