[Q1040] Each of the boys / have submitted / their assignment / on time.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Each of the boys
(b) have submitted
(c) their assignment
(d) on time.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' takes a singular verb and singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद सिंगुलर वर्ब और सिंगुलर प्रोनाउन का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' होगा।
[RULE] Pronoun and Verb Agreement with 'Each of'

[Q1041] Unless you do not / work hard, / you cannot / pass the exam.

(a) Unless you do not
(b) work hard,
(c) you cannot
(d) pass the exam.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Unless' is a negative word itself and does not take another negative word like 'not' in its clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ होता है 'यदि नहीं'। इसके साथ कभी भी 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences / Superfluous Negatives

[Q1042] Mathematics are / a difficult subject / for many students / in school.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Mathematics are
(b) a difficult subject
(c) for many students
(d) in school.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Names of subjects (like Mathematics, Physics, Economics) end in '-s' but take a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. कुछ विषय दिखने में प्लुरल लगते हैं (क्योंकि अंत में 's' होता है) लेकिन वे सिंगुलर होते हैं और उनके साथ सिंगुलर वर्ब ('is') आती है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Nouns ending in -s)

[Q1043] The principal and the manager / has decided / to organize a meeting / tomorrow morning.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The principal and the manager
(b) has decided
(c) to organize a meeting
(d) tomorrow morning.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' and both have articles ('the') before them, they refer to two different persons, requiring a plural verb. Replace 'has' with 'have'.
उदा. जब दो नाउन से पहले 'the' लगा हो और वे 'and' से जुड़ें, तो वे दो अलग व्यक्तियों को दर्शाते हैं, इसलिए वर्ब प्लुरल ('have') होगी।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Articles with Compound Nouns)

[Q1044] He is senior / than me / in age and / experience.
[EXAM: SSC MTS 2023]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) He is senior
(b) than me
(c) in age and
(d) experience.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' (such as senior, junior, superior, inferior) are followed by 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. जिन एडजेक्टिव्स के अंत में 'ior' आता है (जैसे senior, junior आदि), उनके बाद 'than' की जगह हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Preposition with Latin Comparatives (-ior)

[Q1045] Science and technology has / made life much easier / and more comfortable / than ever before
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

[SOL]
When two singular nouns are connected by 'and' to denote different subjects, the verb must be plural ('have'). 
उदा. जब दो या दो से अधिक Singular Nouns को 'and' से जोड़ा जाता है, तो उनके साथ Plural Verb का प्रयोग किया जाता है। यहाँ 'Science' और 'Technology' दो अलग चीजें हैं, इसलिए 'has' की जगह 'have' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1046] No sooner did the sun rise / when we left the house / for our long awaited / journey to the hills
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. 
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' या 'before' का। अतः (B) भाग में 'when' के स्थान पर 'than' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Conjunctions

[Q1047] The principal demanded / to know why I had / not attended the / previous day meeting
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Compound nouns or phrases expressing time should use possessive case or be phrased correctly, like 'the meeting of the previous day' or 'the previous day's meeting'. 
उदा. 'previous day meeting' गलत है। यहाँ 'previous day's meeting' (Possessive case) का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।

[Q1048] Neither of the girls / were willing to / admit their error / during the inquiry
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Neither of', 'Either of', 'Each of' take a singular verb. Therefore, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'. 
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Each of', 'One of' के बाद Noun/Pronoun तो Plural होता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular होती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1049] If I was you / I would not tolerate / such kind of behavior / from anyone
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, not 'was'. 
उदा. कल्पना संबंधी वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी Subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है, चाहे Subject Singular हो या Plural। अतः 'If I was' की जगह 'If I were' होगा।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences

[Q1050] He is one of those persons / who is always / finding fault with / whatever I do

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The verb in a relative clause ('who') agrees with its antecedent ('persons'), which is plural. So 'is' should be 'are'. 
उदा. 'One of those + Plural Noun + Relative Pronoun (who/which/that)' के बाद आने वाली Verb अपने Antecedent (पूर्ववर्ती Noun - persons) के अनुसार Plural होती है। अतः 'is' की जगह 'are' होगा।
[RULE] Relative Pronouns & Verb Agreement

[Q1051] Hardly had I stepped / out of the house / when a heavy downpour / soaked me completely
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2019]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error in this sentence. 'Hardly' is correctly paired with 'when' and the inversion (had I) is correct. 
उदा. इस वाक्य में कोई गलती नहीं है। 'Hardly' के साथ 'when' का प्रयोग होता है और वाक्य का ढांचा (Inversion) बिल्कुल सही है।
[RULE] Inversion & Conjunctions

[Q1052] The company has taken / a decision to launch / a new series of cars / by the next year

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Do not use the preposition 'by' or 'the' before time expressions like 'next year', 'last week', etc. Simply use 'by next year' or 'next year'. 
उदा. 'next year', 'last year', 'tomorrow' आदि शब्दों के पहले Article ('the') या preposition का प्रयोग सामान्यतः नहीं होता जब वे Adverbial use में हों। 'by next year' में 'the' अनावश्यक है।
[RULE] Articles & Prepositions

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

[SOL]
'Each of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular pronoun/verb. 'student' must be 'students'. 
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद Noun हमेशा Plural फॉर्म में होता है। इसलिए 'Each of the student' की जगह 'Each of the students' होना चाहिए।

[Q1054] Not only the principal / but also the teachers / was unhappy with / the student's performance

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

When subjects are joined by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the second subject ('the teachers', which is plural). Use 'were' instead of 'was'. 
उदा. 'Not only... but also' से जब दो Subjects जुड़ते हैं, तो Verb पास वाले (दूसरे) Subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ दूसरा Subject 'the teachers' (Plural) है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।

[Q1072] Spot the error in the following sentence: The in form at i on was collected by the scientists. The in form at i on was collected by the scientists. The in form at i on was collected by the scientists. The in form at i on was collected by the scientists.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
‘Information’ is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb ‘was’. Option B incorrectly uses ‘were’.
उदाहरण: जानकारी वैज्ञानिकों द्वारा एकत्रित की गई।
[RULE] Subject–verb agreement with uncountable nouns

[Q1073] Spot the error in the following sentence: She will bring her bag to the meeting. She will bring her bag to the meeting. She will bring her bag to the meeting. She will bring her bag to the meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The correct phrase is ‘her bag’ not ‘her bag’. Option A mistakenly uses the pronoun ‘her’ as an adjective.
उदाहरण: वह अपनी बैग बैठक में लेकर आएगी।
[RULE] Possessive adjective usage before nouns

[Q1074] Spot the error in the following sentence: He have been studying English for two years. He has been studying English for two years. He have been studying English for two years. He has been studying English for two years.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Option A
(b) Option B
(c) Option C
(d) Option D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correct form is ‘has been studying’. Option C uses the incorrect verb ‘have’.
उदाहरण: वह दो साल से अंग्रेज़ी पढ़ रहा है।
[RULE] Subject–verb agreement in present perfect continuous tense

[Q1075] Hardly had I stepped / out of the house than / a heavy downpour occur red / without any warning.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The conjunction 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when' in part (B).
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः (B) भाग में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Neither of' takes a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (C).
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है। इसलिए (C) में 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' आएगा।

[Q1077] The manager as well as his / subordinates were present / at the emergency meeting / called by the direct or.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager'). Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as', 'with', आदि से जुड़ें, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'The manager' singular है, अतः 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।

[Q1078] She insisted to accompany / her younger brother to the market / despite their mother's / strict instructions.

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'insist' is followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (-ing form), not an infinitive. Replace 'to accompany' with 'on accompanying' in part (A).
उदा. Verb 'insist' के बाद preposition 'on' और gerund (-ing) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (A) में 'to accompany' के स्थान पर 'on accompanying' होगा।

(c) (C)
(d) (D)

'One of' is followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).

(d) (D)

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

[SOL]
In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used with all subjects, not 'was'. Replace 'was' with 'were' in part (A).

[Q1083] Despite of working hard / through out the year, he failed / to secure the top rank / in the university exams.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' does not take 'of' after it (though 'In spite of' does). Remove 'of' from part (A).
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है (जबकि 'In spite' के साथ 'of' आता है)। अतः (A) में 'of' को हटाना होगा।

[Q1084] He is superior than me / in every aspect of the job / and handles complex situations / with great ease.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' (like superior, junior, senior, inferior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than me' with 'to me' in part (A).
उदा. Latin adjectives जिनके अंत में '-or' आता है (जैसे superior, junior), उनके बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (A) में 'than me' की जगह 'to me' होगा।
[RULE] Fixed Prepositions with Adjectives (Superior to)

[Q1085] Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than a heavy downpour / soaked me completely / from head to toe.

(d) from head to toe.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly/Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, 'than' का नहीं। 'Than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है।
[RULE] Conjunction (Hardly ... when)

[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

'Neither of' is singular and takes a singular verb. Replace 'have' with 'has'.

[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' (such as senior, junior, superior, inferior, prior) take 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. Latin comparative adjectives जैसे senior, junior आदि के बाद 'than' के स्थान पर preposition 'to' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।

The phrase 'It is high time' or 'It is time' must be followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.

The structure 'One of + plural noun' takes a singular verb. Replace 'are' with 'is'.

In conditional sentences expressing an imaginary situation, 'were' is used for all subjects with the verb 'to be'. Replace 'was' with 'were'.

[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' must be followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.

[Q1094] Science and technology / has brought about / vital changes in our lives. / No error

(d) No error

When two singular nouns are joined by 'and' to express a single idea or plural subjects, they take a plural verb. Here 'Science and technology' are plural subjects, so 'have' should be used instead of 'has'.

[Q1095] Neither the girl / nor her parents / was present at the party. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the girl
(b) nor her parents
(c) was present at the party.
(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'her parents' (plural), so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने सबसे पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ पास वाला subject 'her parents' (plural) है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Neither...nor'

[Q1096] The direct or as well as / the crew members / were present in the meeting. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The director as well as
(b) the crew members
(c) were present in the meeting.
(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', 'with', 'along with', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject. Here the first subject 'The director' is singular, so 'was' should be used instead of 'were'.
उदा. जब दो subjects 'as well as', 'with' आदि से जुड़ें, तो verb हमेशा पहले subject ('The director' - singular) के अनुसार होती है, इसलिए 'were' के स्थान पर 'was' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'As well as'

[Q1097] Each of the students / in the computer class / have submitted their project. / No error

(c) have submitted their project.
(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Each of', 'Every of', 'Either of' are followed by a plural noun but take a singular verb and singular pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his/her'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb और pronoun हमेशा singular होते हैं। इसलिए 'have' की जगह 'has' और 'their' की जगह 'his' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Pronoun and Verb with 'Each of'

(d) No error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when' or 'before'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.

[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions ('No sooner... than')

[Q1099] Hardly had I arrived / at the station than / the train left. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Hardly had I arrived
(b) at the station than
(c) the train left.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'Hardly' or 'Scarcely' is 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ 'than' का नहीं बल्कि 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Conjunction Pair ('Hardly... when')

[Q1100] She is more smarter / than her sister / in solving puzzles. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more smarter
(b) than her sister
(c) in solving puzzles.
(d) No error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives should not be used together. 'Smart' is a single syllable adjective, so its comparative is 'smarter'. Using 'more' before 'smarter' is incorrect. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक ही adjective के साथ दो comparative words ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'smarter' अपने आप में सही है, इसलिए 'more' हटा दें।
[RULE] Superfluous Comparatives

[Q1101] Unless you do not / work hard, / you cannot pass the exam. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Unless you do not
(b) work hard,
(c) you cannot pass the exam.
(d) No error
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Unless' is a negative word and inherently denotes condition. Never use another negative word like 'not' in the same clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' का अर्थ होता है 'यदि नहीं', इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग करना गलत है। भाग (A) से 'do not' हटाएं।

[Q1102] It is high time / you start preparing / for your upcoming exams. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) It is high time
(b) you start preparing
(c) for your upcoming exams.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Expressions like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are always followed by a verb in the past subjunctive (Simple Past tense). Replace 'start' with 'started'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाली clause हमेशा Simple Past Tense (V2) में होती है। इसलिए 'start' की जगह 'started' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Past Subjunctive after 'It is high time'

[Q1103] He behaves as if / he is the owner / of this large company. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]

(a) He behaves as if
(b) he is the owner
(c) of this large company.
(d) No error
[ANS] b
[SOL]
After 'as if' or 'as though', to denote an unreal situation in the present, we always use 'were' instead of 'is/was' with all subjects. Replace 'is' with 'were'.
उदा. काल्पनिक स्थिति (Hypothetical situation) दर्शाने के लिए 'as if' के साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग किया जाता है, चाहे subject singular ही क्यों न हो।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood ('As if')

(c) was present in the class
(d) yesterday
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.

[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Neither...nor)

[Q1105] She has / read / all the book / yesterday .

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She has
(b) read

(d) yesterday
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The presence of 'yesterday' indicates simple past tense, so 'has read' is incorrect (should be 'read' in simple past). Also, 'all the book' should be 'all the books' because 'book' is countable and plural context is required. Alternatively, 'She read all the books yesterday'.
उदा. वाक्य में 'yesterday' दिया गया है जो भूतकाल (Past tense) को दर्शाता है। साथ ही 'all the' के बाद 'books' (plural) का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Tense and Noun Number Consistency

[Q1106] No sooner did / I open the door / when the bird flew out / into the garden .
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) No sooner did
(b) I open the door
(c) when the bird flew out
(d) into the garden
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when'. Therefore, 'when' should be replaced with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'when' का।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (No sooner... than)

[Q1107] One of my friends / are going / to America / next month .
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) One of my friends
(b) are going
(c) to America
(d) next month
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' takes a plural noun ('friends') but a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद संज्ञा (noun) तो बहुवचन होती है, लेकिन क्रिया (verb) हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है। इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

[Q1108] He is / taller than / me / (No Error) .
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He is
(b) taller than
(c) me
(d) No Error
[ANS] c
[SOL]
In comparative degree, comparison is made between two nominative cases. It should be 'taller than I (am)' instead of 'me'.
उदा. तुलनात्मक वाक्यों में (Comparative degree) दोनों तरफ कर्ता कारक (Nominative case) का प्रयोग होता है। 'me' के स्थान पर 'I' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Pronoun Case in Comparisons

[Q1109] Scarcely had I / arrived at the station / than the train left / without me .

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Scarcely had I
(b) arrived at the station
(c) than the train left
(d) without me
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के बाद संयोजन (conjunction) के रूप में 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Scarcely... when)

[Q1110] The manager as well as / his clerks / were present / at the meeting .

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The manager as well as
(b) his clerks
(c) were present
(d) at the meeting
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager'). Since 'manager' is singular, 'were' should be replaced by 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता ('The manager') के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (as well as)

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Unless you
(b) do not work hard
(c) you cannot
(d) pass the exam

[SOL]
'Unless' is a negative word in itself, so we do not use another negative word like 'not' in the same clause. Remove 'do not'.
उदा. 'Unless' एक नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसलिए इसके साथ 'not' का प्रयोग नहीं किया जाता है। 'do not' को हटाना होगा।
[RULE] Superfluous Negatives (Unless/Until)

(b) he is writing
(c) a letter to his father
(d) at that moment

[RULE] Sequence of Tenses in Indirect Speech

[Q1142] He is working hard / with a view to / secure a top rank. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The phrase 'with a view to' is always followed by a gerund (V1+ing), not a bare infinitive. Replace 'secure' with 'securing' in part (C).
उदा. 'with a view to' के बाद हमेशा Gerund (V1+ing) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः (C) में 'secure' के स्थान पर 'securing' होगा।
[RULE] Fixed Prepositional Phrases with Gerund

---

[Q1143] The captain along with his team members / were present / at the opening ceremony. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two subjects are connected by 'along with', 'as well as', etc., the verb agrees with the first subject ('The captain'). Replace 'were' with 'was' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो Subject 'along with' या 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो Verb पहले Subject के अनुसार आती है। (B) में 'were' की जगह 'was' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (along with)

---

[Q1144] One of the most / important task in / agriculture is the timely / harvesting of crops.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of the' is always followed by a plural noun. Therefore, 'task' should be changed to 'tasks'.
उदा. 'One of the' के बाद हमेशा बहुवचन संज्ञा (Plural Noun) का प्रयोग होता है, इसलिए 'task' की जगह 'tasks' होगा।
[RULE] Noun after One of the

---

[Q1145] Neither the teacher / nor the students / was able to solve / the complex mathematical problem.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the closer subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'was' must be replaced by 'were'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1146] Despite of working / hard through out the year, / he failed to secure / the top rank in the exam.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of'. Either use 'Despite' alone or use 'In spite of'. Therefore, remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता। या तो केवल 'Despite' लिखें या 'In spite of' लिखें।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

---

[Q1147] She is senior / than me / in age by / at least two years.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Adjectives ending in '-or' like senior, junior, superior, inferior take the preposition 'to' instead of 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'to'.
उदा. जिन विशेषणों के अंत में '-or' आता है (जैसे senior, junior आदि), उनके बाद 'than' की जगह 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Fixed Preposition with Adjectives

---

[Q1148] Scarcely had we reached / the station than / the train started moving / very slowly.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by the conjunction 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' के साथ 'than' का नहीं बल्कि 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions

[Q1149] Each of the suspected / terrorists have been / arrested by the / special cyber cell team.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of' takes a singular verb. Therefore, 'have' must be replaced by 'has'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद प्रयुक्त होने वाली क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है। अतः 'have' के स्थान पर 'has' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Each/Every)

---

[Q1150] The committee are / divided in its / opinion regarding / the new policy reforms.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When a collective noun is divided in its opinion, it takes a plural pronoun. Replace 'its' with 'their'.
उदा. जब सामूहिक संज्ञा (Collective Noun) में मतभेद हो, तो उसके साथ बहुवचन सर्वनाम (plural pronoun) का प्रयोग होता है। 'its' की जगह 'their' होगा।
[RULE] Collective Nouns & Pronoun Agreement

---

[Q1151] No sooner did the sun / rise when the villagers / resumed their work / in the green fields.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by the conjunction 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairs (No sooner... than)

[Q1152] Had I realized / the gravity of the situation, / I would not act / in such a reckless manner.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
This is a third conditional sentence structure (Had + V3, would have + V3). Replace 'would not act' with 'would not have acted'.
उदा. यह Third Conditional वाक्य है (Had + V3, would have + V3)। अतः 'would not act' के स्थान पर 'would not have acted' होगा।
[RULE] Conditional Sentences (Type 3)

[Q1153] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The committee have decided to postpone the meeting. B. The committee has decided to postpone the meeting. C. The committee had decided to postpone the meeting. D. The committee will decide to postpone the meeting.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The subject ‘committee’ is singular, so the verb must be singular: *has decided*. Option A uses the plural form *have decided*, which is incorrect.

उदाहरण: "The committee **has** decided to postpone the meeting."
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (singular/plural)

[Q1154] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. She is one of the people who knows the truth. B. She is one of the people who know the truth. C. She is one of the people who are aware of the truth. D. She is one of the people who are aware of the truth.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The relative pronoun ‘who’ refers to the singular noun ‘she’. Therefore the verb must be singular: *knows*. Option B correctly uses *knows*.

उदाहरण: "She is one of the people who **knows** the truth."
[RULE] Agreement of verb with antecedent in relative clauses

[Q1155] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The data was collected from multiple sources. B. The data were collected from multiple sources. C. The data was collected by the team. D. The data were collected by the team.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Although *data* is the plural of *datum*, it is commonly treated as a singular mass noun in modern English. Option B uses the plural verb *were*, which is incorrect in this context.

उदाहरण: "The data **was** collected from multiple sources."
[RULE] Singular vs. plural usage of data

[Q1156] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. Neither the manager nor the employees has submitted the report. B. Neither the manager nor the employees have submitted the report. C. Neither the manager nor the employees had submitted the report. D. Neither the manager nor the employees has submitted the report.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] a
[SOL]
When ‘neither…nor’ is used, the verb agrees with the nearer subject. Here, *employees* is plural, so the verb should be plural: *have submitted*. Option A uses the singular *has*, which is incorrect.

उदाहरण: "Neither the manager nor the employees **have** submitted the report."
[RULE] Verb agreement with neither…nor

[Q1157] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. He was given a lot of in form at i on, which he used to improve the project. B. He was given a lot of in form at i on, which he used to improve the project. C. He was given a lot of in form at i on, and which he used to improve the project. D. He was given a lot of in form at i on, and he used to improve the project.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The clause *which he used to improve the project* is a relative clause and should be connected with a comma alone. Adding *and* creates a grammatical error. Option C incorrectly inserts *and*.

उदाहरण: "He was given a lot of information, which he used to improve the project."
[RULE] Use of relative clauses without conjunctions

[Q1158] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The students, besides their teachers, have been invited. B. The students, besides their teachers, have been invited. C. The students, besides their teachers, has been invited. D. The students, besides their teachers, have been invited.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The main subject is *students* (plural), so the verb must be plural: *have been invited*. Option C uses the singular *has been* which is incorrect.

उदाहरण: "The students, besides their teachers, **have** been invited."
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with non-restrictive clauses

[Q1159] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. She has been working here for five years, and she finds it very rewarding. B. She has been working here for five years, and she finds it very rewarding. C. She has been working here for five years, and she finds it very rewarding. D. She has been working here for five years, and she finds it very rewarding.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is correct; the verb *has been working* matches the subject *she*. Option D is the correct choice.

उदाहरण: "She has been working here for five years, and she finds it very rewarding."
[RULE] Correct use of present perfect continuous

[Q1160] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The company aims to reduce the cost, yet it has not yet done so. B. The company aims to reduce the cost, yet it has not yet done so. C. The company aims to reduce the cost, yet it has not yet done it. D. The company aims to reduce the cost, yet it has not yet done so.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The phrase *has not yet done it* is awkward; the idiomatic expression is *has not yet done so*. Option C misuses *it*.

उदाहरण: "The company aims to reduce the cost, yet it has not yet done so."
[RULE] Use of pronoun 'so' in place of noun phrase

[Q1161] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The research has been published earlier this month. B. The research has been published earlier this month. C. The research had been published earlier this month. D. The research has been published earlier this month.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correct tense is present perfect when the action is relevant to the present. Option C incorrectly uses past perfect *had been published*.

उदाहरण: "The research **has** been published earlier this month."
[RULE] Present perfect vs. past perfect

[Q1162] Identify the sentence with a grammatical error: A. The book, which was printed last year, has been sold out. B. The book, which was printed last year, has been sold out. C. The book, which was printed last year, has been sold out. D. The book, which was printed last year, has been sold out.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) A
(b) B
(c) C
(d) D
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The sentence is correct; the verb *has been sold* matches the subject *book*. Option C is the correct choice.

उदाहरण: "The book, which was printed last year, **has** been sold out."

[Q1163] The manager of the bank was busy, / so he asked me to / come and see him / after two hours.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The manager of the bank was busy,
(b) so he asked me to
(c) come and see him
(d) after two hours.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
Replace 'after two hours' with 'in two hours' because 'after' refers to a point of time in the past, whereas 'in' is used for a future period at the end of which something will happen.
उदा. भविष्य के समय की अवधि के लिए 'after' के स्थान पर 'in' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (In vs After)

[Q1164] Hardly had I stepped out / of the house when a heavy / downpour caused me to / turn back.

(a) Hardly had I stepped out
(b) of the house when a heavy
(c) downpour caused me to
(d) turn back.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Hardly' is correctly followed by 'when' (or 'before'). The sentence is grammatically correct and has no error.
उदा. 'Hardly/Scarcally' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है। वाक्य पूरी तरह सही है।
[RULE] Conjunction (Hardly... when)

[Q1165] Each of the students in the class / have submitted / their assignments / on time.

(a) Each of the students in the class
(b) have submitted
(c) their assignments
(d) on time.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'have' with 'has'. 'Each of + plural noun' takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद plural noun आता है, लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (has) होती है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1166] She is more smarter / than her sister / in solving these / complex puzzles.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) She is more smarter
(b) than her sister
(c) in solving these
(d) complex puzzles.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'more smarter' with 'smarter'. Double comparatives ('more' and 'smarter' together) should not be used.

[RULE] Superfluous / Adjectives

[Q1167] The committee were / divided in its / opinion regarding / the new policy.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The committee were
(b) divided in its
(c) opinion regarding
(d) the new policy.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'its' with 'their'. When a collective noun shows division among members, it takes plural verb and plural pronoun.
उदा. जब collective noun (committee) में मतभेद हो, तो plural pronoun 'their' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'its' का।

[Q1168] Neither the teacher / nor the students was / present in the hall / during the lecture.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students was
(c) present in the hall
(d) during the lecture.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'was' with 'were'. When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject ('students').
उदा. 'Neither... nor' से जुड़े वाक्यों में verb पास वाले subject (students) के अनुसार plural होगी।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Correlative)

[Q1169] He told me that / he has finished / his work two / hours ago.

(a) He told me that
(b) he has finished
(c) his work two
(d) hours ago.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'has finished' with 'had finished'. The main clause is in the past tense ('told'), so the subordinate clause must also be in the past tense.
उदा. मुख्य clause past tense में है, इसलिए आगे का वाक्य भी past tense (had finished) में होगा।
[RULE] Sequence of Tenses

[Q1170] One of my friends / are going to / Chennai for a / software project.

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) One of my friends
(b) are going to
(c) Chennai for a
(d) software project.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'are' with 'is'. The subject is 'One', which is singular, so it takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'One of + plural noun' में मुख्य subject 'One' होता है, इसलिए singular verb 'is' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1171] Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper school uniform
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students
(c) was in their
(d) proper school uniform
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject. Here, 'students' is plural, so the verb and pronoun should be plural ('were in their' instead of 'was in their').
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पास वाले कर्ता के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' बहुवचन है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1172] The manager as well as / his subordinates are / working very hard / to achieve the targets
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) The manager as well as
(b) his subordinates are
(c) working very hard
(d) to achieve the targets
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two subjects are connected by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Hence, use 'is' instead of 'are'.
उदा. जब दो सब्जेक्ट 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो वर्ब पहले सब्जेक्ट ('The manager') के अनुसार सिंगुलर होगी, अतः 'are' के स्थान पर 'is' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'As well as'

[Q1173] No sooner did the train / stoped at the station / than the passengers / rushed out of the compartments
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) No sooner did the train
(b) stoped at the station
(c) than the passengers
(d) rushed out of the compartments
[ANS] b
[SOL]
With the helping verb 'did', the base form of the verb (V1) must be used. 'stoped' is incorrect; it should be 'stop'.
उदा. सहायक क्रिया 'did' के बाद हमेशा वर्ब की पहली फॉर्म (V1) आती है, इसलिए 'stoped' की जगह 'stop' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Use of 'Did' with V1

[Q1174] One of my friends / are going to London / for higher studies / next month
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) One of my friends
(b) are going to London
(c) for higher studies
(d) next month
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun and a singular verb. Therefore, 'are' must be replaced by 'is'.
उदा. 'One of' के बाद नाउन बहुवचन (friends) होता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा एकवचन (singular) होती है, इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' आएगा।
[RULE] One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb

[Q1175] Scarcely had I reached / the exhibition / than the power supply / went completely off
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Scarcely had I reached
(b) the exhibition
(c) than the power supply
(d) went completely off
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'Scarcely' or 'Hardly' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Scarcely' या 'Hardly' के साथ कंजंक्शन 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं (than का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ होता है)।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Scarcely... when)

[Q1176] He is one of those persons / who does not / compromise with his / values under any circumstances
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) He is one of those persons
(b) who does not
(c) compromise with his
(d) values under any circumstances
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who)', the verb following the relative pronoun must agree with the antecedent (persons), which is plural. Replace 'does' with 'do'.
उदा. Relative pronoun 'who' का antecedent 'persons' (plural) है, इसलिए इसके बाद आने वाली वर्ब भी plural ('do') होगी, न कि singular ('does')।
[RULE] Relative Pronoun and Antecedent Agreement

[Q1177] Alas! / The king whom every one / thought was noble / has proved to be a tyrant
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) Alas!
(b) The king whom everyone
(c) thought was noble
(d) has proved to be a tyrant
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Here, the relative pronoun is the subject of the verb 'was' ('who thought was noble'). Therefore, the subjective case 'who' should be used instead of the objective case 'whom'.
उदा. यहाँ वर्ब 'was' के लिए subject की आवश्यकता है, इसलिए objective case 'whom' के स्थान पर subjective case 'who' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Case of Pronoun (Who vs Whom)

[Q1178] Mathematics are a subject / which many students / find extremely difficult / to master
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Mathematics are a subject
(b) which many students
(c) find extremely difficult
(d) to master
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Names of subjects (like Mathematics, Physics, Economics) take a singular verb when used as a name of a discipline. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. कुछ विषय दिखने में बहुवचन लगते हैं लेकिन अर्थ में एकवचन होते हैं (Mathematics), इसलिए इनके साथ singular verb ('is') का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with Nouns ending in '-ics'

[Q1179] It is high time / the government takes / strict actions against / corrupt officials
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) It is high time
(b) the government takes
(c) strict actions against
(d) corrupt officials
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The phrase 'It is high time' or 'It is time' is always followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took'.
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाला वाक्य हमेशा Past Indefinite Tense (V2) में होता है, अतः 'takes' की जगह 'took' आएगा।
[RULE] Tense usage with 'It is high time'

---

[Q1180] Neither of the two candidates / have paid / the subscription fee / for the club member ship
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Neither of the two candidates
(b) have paid
(c) the subscription fee
(d) for the club membership
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' are always followed by a singular verb. Replace 'have' with 'has'.
उदा. 'Neither of' के बाद नाउन plural होता है लेकिन वर्ब हमेशा singular ('has') आती है, इसलिए 'have' गलत है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Neither of'

[Q1181] Hardly had I / reached the station / than the train / left. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I
(b) reached the station
(c) than the train
(d) left.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Hardly/Scarcely is always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के बाद हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। अतः 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairing

[Q1182] Neither the teacher / nor the students / was in their / proper class room. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher
(b) nor the students
(c) was in their
(d) proper classroom.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'students' is plural, so 'were' should be used instead of 'was'.
उदा. 'Neither...nor' से जुड़े होने पर verb पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। यहाँ 'students' plural है, अतः 'was' की जगह 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement

[Q1183] Each of the boys / were given / a heavy bag / of books. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Each of the boys
(b) were given
(c) a heavy bag
(d) of books.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Each of', 'Everyone of', 'Either of', etc., take a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each of' के बाद noun plural होता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular (was) आती है।
[RULE] Pronoun & Verb Agreement

[Q1184] The committee / are divided / in their / opinions regarding this issue. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) The committee
(b) are divided
(c) in their
(d) opinions regarding this issue.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
No error. When a collective noun like 'committee' shows division among members, it takes a plural verb ('are') and plural pronoun ('their').
उदा. कोई त्रुटि नहीं है। जब collective noun में मतभेद दिखाया जाए तो plural verb और plural pronoun का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Collective Noun

[Q1185] No sooner did / the sun rise / when we resumed / our journey. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) No sooner did
(b) the sun rise
(c) when we resumed
(d) our journey.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
'No sooner' is followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.
उदा. 'No sooner' के साथ 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'when' का नहीं।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions

[Q1186] She is one of those persons / who always / helps others / in need. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) She is one of those persons
(b) who always
(c) helps others
(d) in need.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
In 'one of those + plural noun + relative pronoun (who) + plural verb', the verb must agree with the antecedent ('persons'). Replace 'helps' with 'help'.
उदा. 'One of those + plural noun + who' की संरचना में verb antecedent (persons) के अनुसार plural (help) होगी।
[RULE] Relative Pronoun Agreement

[Q1187] Open your book / at page / number tenth / of the text. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) Open your book
(b) at page
(c) number tenth
(d) of the text.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Cardinal numbers are used after nouns to denote page numbers (e.g., Page ten), or ordinal numbers before nouns (e.g., The tenth page). Replace 'page number tenth' with 'page ten'.
उदा. पृष्ठ संख्या दर्शाने के लिए Cardinal number (page ten) का प्रयोग होता है, Ordinal (tenth) का नहीं।
[RULE] Adjectives & Numerals

[Q1188] He told me that / he is going / to buy a new car / the following month. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) He told me that
(b) he is going
(c) to buy a new car
(d) the following month.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
The reporting verb ('told') is in the past tense, so the reported speech must also be in the past tense. Replace 'is' with 'was'.
उदा. यदि reporting verb past tense में हो, तो tense भी past में बदलता है। 'is' की जगह 'was' होगा।
[RULE] Direct and Indirect Speech

[Q1189] Mathematics are / a very difficult / subject for many / school students. /
[EXAM: SSC Stenographer 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]

(c) subject for many
(d) school students.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Certain nouns that look plural (like Mathematics, Physics, News) take a singular verb when used as a name of a subject. Replace 'are' with 'is'.
उदा. कुछ Nouns दिखने में plural लगते हैं पर अर्थ में singular होते हैं (जैसे Mathematics)। इनके साथ singular verb (is) आती है।

[Q1190] Unless you do not / work hard, / you will not / succeed in life. /

(a) Unless you do not

[SOL]
'Unless' is a negative word and does not take another negative ('not') in its clause. Remove 'do not'.

[Q1199] The following paragraph contains a grammatical error in one of the segments. The committee has decided to increase the budget for the new project. The team will finishes the project by December. The manager will brief them about the goals. They will also be given the opportunity to ask questions.

(a) Segment A
(b) Segment B
(c) Segment C
(d) Segment D
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Subject–verb agreement: *will finishes* should be *will finish*.
उदाहरण: वह पुस्तक *पढ़ती है* (present), वह पुस्तक *पढ़ती हैं* (plural).

(a) Segment A
(b) Segment B
(c) Segment C
(d) Segment D

[SOL]
Wrong form of past participle: *has wrote* should be *has written*.
उदाहरण: वह *लिख चुका है* (has written), वह *लिख चुका है* (has written).

[Q1215] He told me that / he is reading / a book for the last / two hours.

(a) He told me that
(b) he is reading
(c) a book for the last
(d) two hours.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Since the reporting verb is in the past tense ('told') and time duration ('for the last two hours') is given, the reported speech must be in the past perfect continuous tense ('he was reading' or 'he had been reading').
उदा. मुख्य वाक्य भूतकाल (told) में है और समय दिया गया है, इसलिए 'is reading' की जगह 'has been reading' या 'was reading' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Sequence of Tenses

[Q1216] Alas! Our leader / is no more / and we are left / in utter darkness.
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Alas! Our leader
(b) is no more
(c) and we are left
(d) in utter darkness.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is completely correct. 'Alas' is an interjection of sorrow, followed by correct grammar. No error.
उदा. वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से पूर्णतः शुद्ध है, इसमें कोई अशुद्धि नहीं है।
[RULE] Interjections and Usage

[Q1217] One of the most important task / in the project is to complete / the documentation before the dead line / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'task' with 'tasks'. The structure 'One of + plural noun + singular verb' requires a plural noun after 'One of'.
उदा. 'task' को 'tasks' से बदलें। 'One of + बहुवचन संज्ञा + एकवचन क्रिया' की संरचना में 'One of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement / Noun after One of

[Q1218] Neither the manager / nor his subordinates was able / to explain the sudden drop in sales. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'was' with 'were'. When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it (subordinates is plural).
उदा. 'was' को 'were' से बदलें। जब दो कर्ता 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता (subordinates जो कि बहुवचन है) के अनुसार होती है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with Neither... nor

[Q1219] She is more smarter / than her sister / in handling complex situations. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Remove 'more'. Double comparatives ('more smarter') are grammatically incorrect. Use 'smarter'.
उदा. 'more' को हटा दें। दो तुलनात्मक शब्दों का एक साथ प्रयोग ('more smarter') गलत है, केवल 'smarter' का प्रयोग करें।
[RULE] Superfluous Comparatives

[Q1220] Despite of his hard work / he failed to secure / the top rank in the examination. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Remove 'of' after 'Despite'. 'Despite' is synonymous with 'In spite of' and does not take 'of' after it.
उदा. 'Despite' के बाद 'of' का प्रयोग न करें। 'Despite' का अर्थ 'In spite of' होता है और इसके साथ 'of' नहीं लगता।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q1221] The committee will meet / tomorrow to discuss about / the new welfare schemes for farmers. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Remove 'about' after 'discuss'. 'Discuss' is a transitive verb and takes a direct object without any preposition.
उदा. 'discuss' के बाद 'about' हटा दें। 'Discuss' एक सकर्मक क्रिया है और इसके बाद सीधे कर्म आता है, बीच में कोई पूर्वसर्ग नहीं लगता।
[RULE] Transitive Verbs without Prepositions

[Q1222] No sooner did the train / arrive at the platform / then the passengers rushed towards it. / No error

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Replace 'then' with 'than'. The correlative conjunction for 'No sooner' is 'than', not 'when' or 'then'.
उदा. 'then' को 'than' से बदलें। 'No sooner' के साथ हमेशा 'than' का प्रयोग होता है, 'then' या 'when' का नहीं।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairs (No sooner... than)

[Q1223] If I was the king / of this country, I would eradicate / poverty and corruption completely. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CPO 2024]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'was' with 'were'. In subjunctive sentences expressing an imaginary wish or condition, 'were' is used with all subjects.
उदा. 'was' को 'were' से बदलें। काल्पनिक इच्छा या शर्त वाले वाक्यों (Subjunctive mood) में सभी कर्ताओं के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood / Conditional Sentences

[Q1224] She is working in this / department for the last / five years with utmost dedication. / No error

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'She is working' with 'She has been working'. Present perfect continuous tense is used for an action starting in the past and continuing into the present with 'for/since'.
उदा. 'She is working' की जगह 'She has been working' का प्रयोग करें। भूतकाल से शुरू होकर वर्तमान तक जारी रहने वाले कार्य के लिए 'for/since' के साथ Present Perfect Continuous Tense आता है।

[Q1225] Each of the suspected men / were interrogated thoroughly / by the senior police officers. / No error

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'were' with 'was'. 'Each of' takes a singular verb because the subject 'Each' is singular.
उदा. 'were' को 'was' से बदलें। 'Each of' के बाद बहुवचन संज्ञा आती है लेकिन क्रिया हमेशा एकवचन (singular verb) होती है क्योंकि मुख्य कर्ता 'Each' है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Each of'

[Q1226] The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policies. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule in English: The word "policy" is used in singular form, but "policies" (plural) is required to match the plural subject "new" when referring to multiple policies.
उदा. गलत वाक्य: The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policies.
सही वाक्य: The committee will convene tomorrow to discuss the new policy.
[RULE] Subject-verb agreement / Plural noun usage

[Q1227] He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. He has been working here since five years. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use "for" with a duration and "since" with a point in time. The correct phrase is "since five years" is incorrect; it should be "for five years".
उदा. गलत वाक्य: He has been working here since five years.
सही वाक्य: He has been working here for five years.
[RULE] Use of for and since for time expressions

[Q1228] The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. The research was conducted by the team last year. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: When a verb is in passive voice, the auxiliary should be "was" for singular subject "research". Here the verb is correct but the object "team" should be preceded by "by" once; the error is that the phrase "by the team" is repeated unnecessarily. The correct segment is (B).
उदा. गलत वाक्य: The research was conducted by the team last year.
सही वाक्य: The research was conducted by the team last year.
[RULE] Passive voice construction

[Q1229] They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week. They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use "next week" without the article "the" when referring to the upcoming week. So (B) and (D) are correct, but the question marks the use of "the next week" in (A) and (C) as incorrect.
उदा. गलत वाक्य: They have decided to postpone the meeting until the next week.
सही वाक्य: They have decided to postpone the meeting until next week.
[RULE] Use of articles with time expressions

[Q1230] The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. The new manager, along with his team, will attend the conference. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: When using a non‑essential clause with commas, the subject of the clause should agree with the antecedent. Here the clause "along with his team" is non‑essential and the verb should remain singular "will attend". The error lies in (A) where the comma placement makes it ambiguous. Correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Comma usage with non‑essential clauses

[Q1231] The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line The students had finished their assignment before the dead line Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: The past perfect tense is used when an action was completed before another past action. Here the correct form is "had finished". The error is that (A) uses the simple past "finished" instead of past perfect. Correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Past perfect tense usage

[Q1232] She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. She has been studying at the university for three years. Which segment contains an error?

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: Use "for" with a duration and "since" with a point of time. The phrase "for three years" is correct; the error is in (A) where "has been studying" is fine, but the context might require "has been studying" with "since" if a starting point is mentioned. However, in this sentence, (A) is correct and the error is in the other segments where the verb tense is wrong. The correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Use of for and since for time expressions

[Q1233] The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. The report, which was submitted yesterday, will be reviewed by the manager. Which segment contains an error?
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2021 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: A non‑essential relative clause (introduced by "which") must be set off by commas. The error is the missing comma after "report" in (A). The correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।
[RULE] Comma usage with non‑essential clauses

[Q1234] The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line The applicants were required to submit their documents before the dead line Which segment contains an error?

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: The past simple "were required" is correct, but the error is that the phrase "their documents" should be "their documents" (no error). However, in the original sentence, (A) uses the wrong tense "were required" while the correct tense is "were required to". The correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q1235] The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. The new policy will be implemented after the meeting. Which segment contains an error?

(a) Segment (A)
(b) Segment (B)
(c) Segment (C)
(d) Segment (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Rule in English: The phrase "after the meeting" is acceptable, but the error lies in the use of the singular noun "policy" with a plural verb. In (A), the verb "will be implemented" is correctly singular, but the error is that the article "the" before "new policy" is missing. The correct segment is (B).
💡 हिन्दी व्याख्या: सही विकल्प 'Segment (A)' है। वाक्य के व्याकरणिक नियमों के अनुसार इसे शुद्ध किया गया है।

[Q1236] Hardly had I stepped / out of the house / when a heavy shower / caught me completely.

(a) (A) Hardly had I stepped
(b) (B) out of the house
(c) (C) when a heavy shower
(d) (D) caught me completely.
[ANS] d
[SOL]
No error in this sentence. 'Hardly' is correctly followed by 'had + subject + V3' in the first clause and 'when' in the second clause.

[RULE] Inversion and Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q1237] She insisted to go / to the market alone / despite the heavy / rain warning.

(a) (A) She insisted to go
(b) (B) to the market alone
(c) (C) despite the heavy
(d) (D) rain warning.
[ANS] a

Replace 'insisted to go' with 'insisted on going'. The verb 'insist' is always followed by the preposition 'on' and a gerund (V1+ing).
उदा. 'insisted to go' की जगह 'insisted on going' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'insist' के बाद हमेशा प्रीपोजिशन 'on' और उसके बाद जेरंड (gerund) आता है।

[Q1238] One of the most important / feature of this book / is its simple and / lucid language.

(b) (B) feature of this book
(c) (C) is its simple and
(d) (D) lucid language.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'feature' with 'features'. The phrase 'One of' is always followed by a plural noun or pronoun.

[RULE] Noun Form after 'One of'

[Q1239] No sooner did the train / arrived at the station / than the passengers / rushed towards it.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A) No sooner did the train
(b) (B) arrived at the station
(c) (C) than the passengers
(d) (D) rushed towards it.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'arrived' with 'arrive'. 'Did' is a helping verb and is always followed by the base form of the verb (V1).
उदा. 'arrived' की जगह 'arrive' होगा क्योंकि 'did' के साथ हमेशा वर्ब की पहली फॉर्म (V1) का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
[RULE] Do/Does/Did + V1

[Q1240] The manager asked him / that why he was / coming late to the office / for past several days.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A) The manager asked him
(b) (B) that why he was
(c) (C) coming late to the office
(d) (D) for past several days.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Remove 'that' in segment (B). In indirect speech for WH-questions (why, what, where), conjunction 'that' is not used before the question word.
उदा. भाग (B) में 'that' का प्रयोग गलत है। Indirect speech में WH-word (why) से पहले 'that' नहीं लगाया जाता।

[Q1241] Despite of working hard / he could not clear / the competitive exam / in his first attempt.

[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A) Despite of working hard
(b) (B) he could not clear
(c) (C) the competitive exam
(d) (D) in his first attempt.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Replace 'Despite of' with 'Despite' or 'In spite of'. 'Despite' does not take 'of' after it, whereas 'In spite' takes 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite of' की जगह केवल 'Despite' या 'In spite of' का प्रयोग करें क्योंकि 'Despite' के साथ 'of' नहीं आता है।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (Despite vs In spite of)

[Q1242] Each of the suspected / terrorists have been / arrested by the police / early this morning.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A) Each of the suspected
(b) (B) terrorists have been
(c) (C) arrested by the police
(d) (D) early this morning.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Replace 'have been' with 'has been'. The pronoun 'Each' is singular and takes a singular verb.
उदा. 'have been' को 'has been' से बदलें क्योंकि 'Each' एक सिंगुलर सब्जेक्ट है और इसके साथ सिंगुलर वर्ब आती है।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Each'

[Q1243] Scarcely had we reached / the exhibition ground / than it started / raining heavily.
[EXAM: SSC CHSL 2024 Tier-1]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A) Scarcely had we reached
(b) (B) the exhibition ground
(c) (C) than it started
(d) (D) raining heavily.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
Replace 'than' with 'when'. 'Scarcely' or 'Barely' is always followed by 'when' or 'before', whereas 'No sooner' is followed by 'than'.
उदा. 'than' की जगह 'when' का प्रयोग करें क्योंकि 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का जोड़ा बनता है।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Scarcely... when)

[Q1244] Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than a heavy downpour / caught me completely unawares. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not by 'than'. 'Than' is used with 'No sooner'. Therefore, replace 'than' with 'when' in part (B).
उदा. 'Hardly' के साथ हमेशा 'when' का प्रयोग होता है, न कि 'than' का। 'than' का प्रयोग 'No sooner' के साथ किया जाता है। अतः भाग (B) में 'than' की जगह 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Conjunction Pairing (Hardly... when)

[Q1245] Neither of the two candidates / have paid their subscription / to the club for the year. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Neither of', 'Either of', and 'Each of' are followed by a plural noun/pronoun but take a singular verb and singular possessive pronoun. Replace 'have' with 'has' and 'their' with 'his' in part (B).
उदा. 'Neither of', 'Either of' के बाद plural noun/pronoun आता है लेकिन verb हमेशा singular होती है। 'have' की जगह 'has' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Neither of + Singular Verb)

[Q1246] The principal along with all the teachers / are going to attend / the seminar tomorrow. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'along with', 'as well as', 'together with', the verb agrees with the first subject. Here, 'The principal' is singular, so replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).
उदा. जब दो subjects 'along with', 'as well as' आदि से जुड़े हों, तो verb पहले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'The principal' singular है, इसलिए 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Along with)

[Q1247] She told to me / that she would not be able / to attend the meeting. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] a
[SOL]
The verb 'tell' is a transitive verb and does not take a preposition like 'to' before its indirect object. Replace 'told to me' with 'told me' in part (A).
उदा. 'Tell' के बाद कभी भी preposition 'to' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है जबकि 'said' के बाद 'to' आ सकता है। अतः 'told to me' गलत है।
[RULE] Transitive Verbs (Tell vs Say)

[Q1248] No sooner did the train arrive / than the passengers rushed / towards the compartments. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] d
[SOL]
The sentence is grammatically correct. 'No sooner' is correctly followed by the auxiliary verb 'did', the base form of the verb 'arrive', and the conjunction 'than'.
उदा. वाक्य पूरी तरह से सही है। 'No sooner' के साथ 'did' और फिर 'than' का सही संयोजन किया गया है।
[RULE] No Error / Inversion

[Q1249] It is high time / that the government takes / strict action against corruption. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
Expressions like 'It is time', 'It is high time', 'It is about time' are followed by a clause in the Simple Past tense (V2). Replace 'takes' with 'took' in part (B).
उदा. 'It is high time' के बाद आने वाली clause में Past Indefinite Tense (V2) का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'takes' की जगह 'took' होगा।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood (It is high time + V2)

[Q1250] One of my friends / are a renowned scientist / working in NASA. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'One of' is always followed by a plural noun but the verb associated with it is singular because the subject is 'One'. Replace 'are' with 'is' in part (B).
उदा. 'One of' के बाद plural noun आता है लेकिन verb singular होती है क्योंकि मुख्य subject 'One' होता है। अतः 'are' की जगह 'is' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (One of + Plural Noun + Singular Verb)

[Q1251] He walked as if / he is lame / though he was perfectly fine. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'As if' or 'as though' denotes an unreal condition, which is always followed by 'were' (regardless of the subject). Replace 'is' with 'were' in part (B).
उदा. 'As if' या 'as though' काल्पनिक स्थिति को दर्शाते हैं, जिसके साथ हमेशा 'were' का प्रयोग होता है। 'is' की जगह 'were' सही होगा।
[RULE] Subjunctive Mood (As if + were)

[Q1252] Scarcely had we reached the station / when the train started moving / in full speed. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] c
[SOL]
The correct prepositional idiom is 'at full speed', not 'in full speed'. Replace 'in' with 'at' in part (C).
उदा. यहाँ निश्चित मुहावरेदार प्रयोग (Fixed preposition) की गलती है। 'in full speed' की जगह 'at full speed' होना चाहिए।
[RULE] Preposition Usage (at full speed)

[Q1253] Not only the principal / but also the students was / involved in the protest. / No error
[EXAM: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-2]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are connected by 'not only... but also', the verb agrees with the subject closest to it. Here, 'the students' is plural, so replace 'was' with 'were' in part (B).
उदा. जब subjects 'not only... but also' से जुड़े हों, तो verb अपने पास वाले subject के अनुसार आती है। 'the students' plural है, इसलिए 'was' की जगह 'were' होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement (Not only... but also)

[Q1254] The manager as well as his subordinates / were present at the meeting / which was held yesterday / in the main auditorium.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) The manager as well as his subordinates
(b) were present at the meeting
(c) which was held yesterday
(d) in the main auditorium.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When two subjects are joined by 'as well as', the verb agrees with the first subject ('The manager', which is singular). Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. जब दो कर्ता 'as well as' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पहले कर्ता ('The manager' - एकवचन) के अनुसार आती है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' का प्रयोग होगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'as well as'

[Q1255] Hardly had I stepped out of the house / than it started raining heavily / and I had to return / to get an umbrella.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Hardly had I stepped out of the house
(b) than it started raining heavily
(c) and I had to return
(d) to get an umbrella.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
'Hardly' and 'Scarcely' are always followed by 'when' or 'before', not 'than'. Replace 'than' with 'when'.
उदा. 'Hardly' या 'Scarcely' के साथ हमेशा 'when' या 'before' का प्रयोग होता है, 'than' का नहीं। इसलिए 'than' के स्थान पर 'when' होगा।
[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions (Hardly... when)

[Q1256] Neither the teacher nor the students / was paying attention / to the lecture delivered / by the guest speaker.

[DIFFICULTY: Medium]
(a) Neither the teacher nor the students
(b) was paying attention
(c) to the lecture delivered
(d) by the guest speaker.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
When subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the nearest subject ('the students', which is plural). Replace 'was' with 'were'.
उदा. जब दो विषय 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया निकटतम कर्ता ('the students' - बहुवचन) के अनुसार होती है। अतः 'was' के स्थान पर 'were' आएगा।
[RULE] Subject-Verb Agreement with 'Neither... nor'

[Q1257] She is one of those persons / who always speaks / the truth no matter what / the consequences might be.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) She is one of those persons
(b) who always speaks
(c) the truth no matter what
(d) the consequences might be.
[ANS] b
[SOL]
In the structure 'one of + plural noun + relative pronoun (who/which/that)', the verb following the relative pronoun must be plural to agree with the plural noun ('persons'). Replace 'speaks' with 'speak'.
उदा. 'one of + बहुवचन संज्ञा + relative pronoun (who)' की बनावट में relative pronoun के बाद आने वाली क्रिया बहुवचन ('speak') होती है क्योंकि वह 'persons' को संदर्भित करती है।
[RULE] Relative Pronoun & Verb Agreement

[Q1258] The furniture in his new house / look quite impressive / and adds a touch of elegance / to the living room.

(c) and adds a touch of elegance

[RULE] Uncountable Nouns and Singular Verbs

[Q1259] No sooner did the train stop / at the railway station / when the passengers rushed / towards the exit gate.

[SOL]
'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.

[Q1260] Each of the suspected boys / were interrogated thoroughly / by the police officers / regarding the stolen bicycle.

(d) regarding the stolen bicycle.

[SOL]
Words like 'Each', 'Every', 'Everyone', 'Either', 'Neither' are singular and take a singular verb. Replace 'were' with 'was'.
उदा. 'Each', 'Every', 'Either', 'Neither' आदि के साथ हमेशा एकवचन (singular) क्रिया का प्रयोग होता है। इसलिए 'were' की जगह 'was' आएगा।

[Q1261] Despite of working hard / through out the semester, / he failed to secure / the top rank in class.

(c) he failed to secure
(d) the top rank in class.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
'Despite' is never followed by 'of' (Despite = In spite of). Remove 'of'.
उदा. 'Despite' के साथ कभी भी 'of' का प्रयोग नहीं होता है (चूँकि Despite = In spite of)। अतः 'of' को हटाना होगा।

[Q1262] Rohan is more taller / than his elder brother / who works in Mumbai / as a software engineer.
[EXAM: SSC Selection Post Phase XI (2023)]
[DIFFICULTY: Easy]
(a) Rohan is more taller
(b) than his elder brother
(c) who works in Mumbai
(d) as a software engineer.
[ANS] a
[SOL]
Double comparatives are incorrect in English. 'Taller' is already comparative, so 'more' should not be used before it. Remove 'more'.
उदा. एक ही विशेषण के साथ दो तुलनात्मक शब्दों ('more' और '-er') का एक साथ प्रयोग नहीं होता। 'taller' स्वयं तुलनात्मक है, अतः 'more' का प्रयोग गलत है।
[RULE] Superfluous / Double Comparatives

[Q1263] She has completed / her graduation in 2020 / and since then she works / in a multinational company.

[DIFFICULTY: Hard]
(a) She has completed
(b) her graduation in 2020
(c) and since then she works
(d) in a multinational company.
[ANS] c
[SOL]
When an action started in the past and continues into the present with 'since then', the Present Perfect Continuous tense (or Present Perfect) must be used. Replace 'works' with 'has been working'.
उदा. यदि कोई कार्य भूतकाल में शुरू हुआ हो और 'since then' के साथ वर्तमान तक जारी हो, तो Present Perfect Continuous tense का प्रयोग होता है। अतः 'works' की जगह 'has been working' होगा।
[RULE] Tenses with 'Since then'

(a) (A)
(b) (B)
(c) (C)
(d) (D)

When two subjects are joined by 'neither... nor', the verb agrees with the subject nearest to it. Here, the nearest subject is 'his subordinates', which is plural. Therefore, use 'have' instead of 'has'.

'No sooner' is always followed by 'than', not 'when' or 'then'. Replace 'when' with 'than'.

[RULE] Correlative Conjunctions

[RULE] Direct and Indirect Speech Narration Rules

[Q1268] Unless you do not / work hard, / you cannot / pass the examination.

[Q1269] He is superior / than me / in mathematics / and physics.

(a) (A)
